title.zh: 卷四十五 本紀第四十五 理宗五
title.raw: 卷四十五 本紀第四十五 理宗五 Volume 45 Annals 45: Lizong 5

sentences.zh: 景定元年春正月丙子，詔獎賈似道功。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding, first month of spring, on bingzi, an edict commended Jia Sidao's achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingding, on bingzi in the first month of spring, an edict commended Jia Sidao for his achievements.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，歲星、熒惑合在尾。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Jupiter and Mars conjoined in the Tail [asterism].
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jupiter and Mars conjoined in the Tail asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔：「知涪州趙，聚糧不運餉兵士，遂爲北有，已削一秩，罰輕，再削兩秩。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict stated: "Zhao, prefect of Fuzhou, gathered grain but did not transport provisions to supply the troops, thereby making it available to the north; he had already been demoted one rank, but the penalty was too light, and he is demoted two more ranks."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, an edict declared that Zhao, prefect of Fuzhou, had stockpiled grain yet failed to forward provisions to the troops, thereby allowing supplies to fall to the northern enemy; having already been demoted one rank, he was judged too lightly punished and was demoted two further ranks.

sentences.zh: 」乙未，潼川城仙侶山。

translations.literal: On weimi, Tongchuan fortified Xianlü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On weimi, Tongchuan fortified Xianlü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賈似道言：「高達守鄂州城凡三月，大元師北還。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao reported: "Gao Da defended the city of Ezhou for three months in all, and the Great Yuan army returned north."
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao reported that Gao Da had held Ezhou for three full months before the Great Yuan forces withdrew north.

sentences.zh: 」二月丙午，詔賈似道以緡錢三千萬犒師，並示賞功之典。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingwu, an edict ordered Jia Sidao to reward the army with thirty million strings of cash and to display the standards for rewarding merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingwu, an edict directed Jia Sidao to distribute thirty million strings of cash to reward the troops and to publish the standards for honoring merit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以高達爲寧江軍承宣使、右金吾衛上將軍，賜緡錢五十萬；

translations.literal: On jiyou, Gao Da was appointed Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningjiang Army and Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, and was granted five hundred thousand strings of cash;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Gao Da was made Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningjiang Army and Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, with a grant of five hundred thousand strings of cash;

sentences.zh: 呂文德賜緡錢百萬、浙西良田百頃；

translations.literal: Lü Wende was granted one million strings of cash and one hundred qing of fertile land in western Zhejiang;
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende received one million strings of cash and one hundred qing of fertile land in western Zhejiang;

sentences.zh: 鄂州戰守將士賜緡錢三千萬；

translations.literal: the officers and soldiers who fought and defended at Ezhou were granted thirty million strings of cash;
translations.idiomatic: the officers and soldiers who had fought and held Ezhou were granted thirty million strings of cash;

sentences.zh: 王鑒、孫虎臣、蘇劉義等各官十轉。

translations.literal: Wang Jian, Sun Huchen, Su Liuyi, and others each advanced ten ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, Sun Huchen, Su Liuyi, and the rest each advanced ten ranks in office.

sentences.zh: 高達遷湖北安撫副使、知江陵府兼夔路策應使，陳奕、阮思聰並正任防禦使。

translations.literal: Gao Da was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Hubei Pacification Commission, prefect of Jiangling, and concurrently Coordinator for the Kuizhou Circuit; Chen Yi and Ruan Sicong were both appointed regular commissioners of defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Da was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Hubei Pacification Commission and prefect of Jiangling, with concurrent duty as Kuizhou Circuit coordinator; Chen Yi and Ruan Sicong were both given regular appointments as commissioners of defense.

sentences.zh: 江西、湖南帥司言：大元兵破瑞州、臨江軍城，興國、壽昌、洪、撫、全、永、衡諸郡民皆被兵，存者奔竄它所。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Jiangxi and Hunan reported: Great Yuan troops had taken the cities of Ruizhou and Linjiang Army; the people of Xingguo, Shouchang, Hong, Fu, Quan, Yong, and Heng prefectures had all suffered warfare, and those who survived fled elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi and Hunan commanders reported that Great Yuan forces had captured Ruizhou and Linjiang Army, that the populace of Xingguo, Shouchang, Hong, Fu, Quan, Yong, and Heng had all been caught up in the fighting, and that survivors had fled to other regions.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔臨江守臣陳元桂死節，官五轉，贈寶章閣待制。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict noted that Chen Yuangui, defender of Linjiang, had died upholding his integrity; he was promoted five ranks and posthumously made Awaiting Draftsman of the Baozhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, an edict honored Chen Yuangui, the Linjiang defender, for dying in faithful service; he was promoted five ranks and posthumously made Awaiting Draftsman of the Baozhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 與一子京官、一子選人恩澤。

translations.literal: One son was granted a capital-office appointment and one son a selectee's favor.
translations.idiomatic: One son received a capital-office appointment and one son a selectee's favor.

sentences.zh: 給緡錢十萬治葬，立廟死所，諡曰正節。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand strings of cash were granted for his burial, a temple was erected at the place of his death, and his posthumous title was Upright Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted one hundred thousand strings of cash for burial expenses, a temple was erected where he had died, and he was given the posthumous title Upright Integrity.

sentences.zh: 瑞州守臣陳昌世治郡雖有善政，兵至，民擁之以逃，以棄城失守，削三秩勒停。

translations.literal: Chen Changshi, defender of Ruizhou, though his governance of the prefecture had good policies, when the army arrived the people surrounded him to flee; for abandoning the city and losing it he was demoted three ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Changshi of Ruizhou, though he had governed well, was surrounded by the populace and driven to flee when the enemy arrived; for abandoning the city he was demoted three ranks and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，詔孫虎臣和州防禦使，張世傑以下十三人各官五轉；

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict appointed Sun Huchen Commissioner of Defense of Hezhou; Zhang Shijie and the twelve below him each advanced five ranks;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict made Sun Huchen Commissioner of Defense of Hezhou; Zhang Shijie and twelve others each advanced five ranks;

sentences.zh: 立功將士並補兩官資，賜銀絹。

translations.literal: officers and soldiers who had achieved merit were all granted two additional ranks and given silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: meritorious officers and soldiers were each granted two additional ranks and rewarded with silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 庚申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On gengshen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大元遣偏師自大理由廣南抵衡州，向士璧會合劉雄飛逆戰於道，俘民獲還者甚衆。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Great Yuan sent a detached force from Dali by way of Guangnan to reach Hengzhou; Xiang Shibi joined Liu Xiongfei to give battle on the road, and very many captured civilians were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Great Yuan sent a detached column from Dali through Guangnan toward Hengzhou; Xiang Shibi joined Liu Xiongfei to engage them on the march and recovered a great many civilians who had been taken captive.

sentences.zh: 詔雄飛升保康軍承宣使，餘轉官、賜銀錢。

translations.literal: An edict promoted Xiongfei to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army; the rest received rank promotions and grants of silver and cash.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Liu Xiongfei to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army, while the others received promotions and grants of silver and cash.

sentences.zh: 賈似道賜金器千兩、幣千匹，命國子監主簿劉錫趣召赴闕。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao was granted one thousand liang of gold vessels and one thousand bolts of silk, and Director Liu Xi of the Directorate of Education was ordered to summon him urgently to court.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao received one thousand liang of gold vessels and one thousand bolts of silk, and Liu Xi, director of the Directorate of Education, was ordered to summon him urgently to court.

sentences.zh: 向士璧遷兵部侍郎，職任依舊。

translations.literal: Xiang Shibi was transferred to Vice Minister of War, his duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Shibi was transferred to Vice Minister of War while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 呂文德、高達、陳奕等各賜金幣有差。

translations.literal: Lü Wende, Gao Da, Chen Yi, and others were each granted gold and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende, Gao Da, Chen Yi, and the others each received grants of gold and silk in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大元軍過分寧、武寧二縣，河湖砦都監權巡檢張興宗死之，詔贈武翼郎，官一子承信郎，以緡錢三萬給其家。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Great Yuan troops passed through Fenning and Wuning counties; Zhang Xingzong, superintendent of the River-Lake Stockade and acting inspector, died; an edict posthumously made him Military-Winged Gentleman, appointed one son Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and granted thirty thousand strings of cash to his family.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Great Yuan forces passed through Fenning and Wuning; Zhang Xingzong, superintendent of the River-Lake Stockade and acting inspector, was killed; an edict posthumously made him Military-Winged Gentleman, appointed one son Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and granted his family thirty thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 湖南諸將溫和轉左武大夫、帶行遙郡刺史，李虎官三轉、帶行閣門宣贊，鄮進帶行復州團練使，各賜銀絹，旌其守禦之功。

translations.literal: The Hunan generals Wen He was promoted to Left Martial Grandee with acting distant-prefecture prefect, Li Hu advanced three ranks with acting Palace Gate Proclaimer, and Yin Jin acting regimental trainer of Fuzhou; each was granted silver and silk in recognition of their defensive achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Hunan commanders, Wen He was promoted to Left Martial Grandee with acting distant-prefecture prefect, Li Hu advanced three ranks with acting Palace Gate Proclaimer, and Yin Jin was given acting regimental trainer of Fuzhou; each received silver and silk in recognition of their defensive service.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuchen the new moon day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon, wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命夏貴兼黃、壽策應使，總舟師。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xia Gui was ordered to serve concurrently as Coordinator for Huang and Shou and to command the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xia Gui was ordered to serve concurrently as coordinator for Huang and Shou and to take overall command of the fleet.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以橫山之戰將士效節，多死行陣，總管張世雄、沈彥雄、陳喜、秦安、李孝信、鄭俊、李安國各贈十官資，賜緡錢萬恤其家。

translations.literal: On guiyou, because the officers and soldiers at the battle of Hengshan had shown loyal devotion and many died in the ranks, the commanders Zhang Shixiong, Shen Yanxiong, Chen Xi, Qin An, Li Xiaoxin, Zheng Jun, and Li Anguo were each posthumously granted ten ranks, and ten thousand strings of cash were granted to comfort their families.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, because the troops at Hengshan had fought with loyal devotion and many had fallen in battle, the commanders Zhang Shixiong, Shen Yanxiong, Chen Xi, Qin An, Li Xiaoxin, Zheng Jun, and Li Anguo were each posthumously granted ten ranks, and ten thousand strings of cash were allotted to comfort their families.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賞夏貴鴻宿州、白鹿磯戰功，遷福州觀察使，職任仍舊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Xia Gui was rewarded for his achievements at Hongsu Prefecture and Bailu Jetty, transferred to Commissioner of Fuzhou, his duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Xia Gui was rewarded for his victories at Hongsu Prefecture and Bailu Jetty, promoted to Commissioner of Fuzhou while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 將士推賞。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers received extended rewards.
translations.idiomatic: His officers and soldiers received extended rewards.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔全、嶽、永、衡、柳、象、瑞、興國、南康、隆興、江州、臨江、潭州諸縣經兵，農民失業，應開慶元年以前二稅盡除之。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict stated that in the counties of Quan, Yue, Yong, Heng, Liu, Xiang, Rui, Xingguo, Nankang, Longxing, Jiangzhou, Linjiang, and Tanzhou that had suffered warfare, the farmers had lost their livelihoods, and the two tax levies due before the first year of Kaiqing were all to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, an edict declared that in counties throughout Quan, Yue, Yong, Heng, Liu, Xiang, Rui, Xingguo, Nankang, Longxing, Jiangzhou, Linjiang, and Tanzhou that had been ravaged by war, farmers had lost their livelihoods, and all two-tax levies owed before the first year of Kaiqing were to be remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賈似道奏蘱草坪大戰，進至黃州。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Jia Sidao memorialized a great battle at Weicao Plain and an advance to Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jia Sidao reported a major battle at Weicao Plain and an advance to Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔範文虎轉左武大夫、環衛官、黃州武定諸軍都統制，張世傑環衛官、職任依舊。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict transferred Fan Wenhu to Left Martial Grandee, Imperial Guard officer, and Commander-in-Chief of the Wuding Armies of Huangzhou; Zhang Shijie was made Imperial Guard officer, his duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, an edict promoted Fan Wenhu to Left Martial Grandee, Imperial Guard officer, and Commander-in-Chief of the Wuding Armies of Huangzhou; Zhang Shijie was made Imperial Guard officer while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 鄂州統制張勝死于漢陽戰陣，贈官五轉，官其子煥進武校尉。

translations.literal: Zhang Sheng, commander of Ezhou, died in battle at Hanyang; he was posthumously promoted five ranks, and his son Huan was appointed Martial Cadet.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Sheng, the Ezhou commander, fell in battle at Hanyang; he was posthumously promoted five ranks, and his son Huan was appointed Martial Cadet.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賈似道言，自鄂趨黃，與北朝回軍相遇，諸將用命捍禦。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Jia Sidao reported that marching from E to Huang he had encountered the northern court's returning army, and the generals had devoted themselves to defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Jia Sidao reported that marching from Ezhou toward Huangzhou he had met the northern court's returning army, and his generals had fought devotedly in defense.

sentences.zh: 詔孫虎臣、範文虎、張世傑以下各賜金帛。

translations.literal: An edict granted Sun Huchen, Fan Wenhu, Zhang Shijie, and those below them gold and silk each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Sun Huchen, Fan Wenhu, Zhang Shijie, and the others gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，侍御史沈炎疏吳潛過失，以「忠王之立，人心所屬，潛獨不然，章汝鈞對館職策，乞爲濟邸立後，潛樂聞其論，授汝鈞正字，奸謀叵測。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu the new moon day, Remonstrating Censor Shen Yan memorialized Wu Qian's faults, stating: "When Prince Zhong was established, the hearts of the people were his; Qian alone was not in agreement. Zhang Rujun, answering the examination for an academy post, begged that an heir be established for the Residence of Ji; Qian was pleased to hear his argument and appointed Rujun Corrector—his treacherous designs are unfathomable."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon, wuxu, Remonstrating Censor Shen Yan memorialized against Wu Qian, writing that when Prince Zhong was made heir the people's hearts had been with him while Qian alone had dissented; that Zhang Rujun, in his examination for an academy post, had pleaded for an heir to be established for the Residence of Ji; that Qian had welcomed this argument and appointed Rujun Corrector—his treacherous designs could not be fathomed.

sentences.zh: 請速詔賈似道正位鼎軸。

translations.literal: He requested that Jia Sidao be quickly ordered to take his proper place as chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: He urged that Jia Sidao be promptly ordered to assume his proper place as chief minister.

sentences.zh: 」詔朱熠、戴慶炣輪日判事，大政則共議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhu Yi and Dai Qingci to adjudicate affairs in rotation by day; on major policies they were to deliberate jointly and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Zhu Yi and Dai Qingci to adjudicate routine affairs in daily rotation, while major policies were to be deliberated jointly and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賈似道表言夏貴等戰新生洲，進至白鹿磯，皆身自督戰有功。

translations.literal: On jihai, Jia Sidao memorialized that Xia Gui and others had fought at Xinsheng Isle and advanced to Bailu Jetty, all personally supervising the battles with merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Jia Sidao reported that Xia Gui and others had fought at Xinsheng Isle and advanced to Bailu Jetty, each having personally directed the fighting with distinction.

sentences.zh: 詔赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them to proceed to court.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以王堅爲侍衛步軍司都指揮使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Wang Jian was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Step Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Jian was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Step Army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以劉整知瀘州兼潼川安撫副使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Liu Zheng was appointed prefect of Luzhou and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Tongchuan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Liu Zheng was made prefect of Luzhou and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Tongchuan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 己酉，揚州大火。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a great fire broke out in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a great fire broke out in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 吳潛以觀文殿大學士提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Wu Qian was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qian was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and assigned to superintend the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進賈似道少師，依前右丞相兼樞密使，進封衛國公；

translations.literal: On guichou, Jia Sidao was advanced to Junior Preceptor, remaining as before Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Weiguo;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jia Sidao was promoted to Junior Preceptor, retained as Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and enfeoffed as Duke of Weiguo;

sentences.zh: 朱熠知樞密院事兼參知政事；

translations.literal: Zhu Yi was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councillor;

sentences.zh: 饒虎臣參知政事；

translations.literal: Rao Huchen was made Vice Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: Rao Huchen was made Vice Grand Councillor;

sentences.zh: 戴慶炣同知樞密院事兼參知政事，皮龍榮端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Dai Qingci was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councillor; Pi Longrong was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and Concurrent Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Qingci was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councillor; Pi Longrong was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and concurrent signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，以夏貴爲保康軍承宣使、左金吾衛上將軍、知淮安州兼淮東安撫副使、京東招撫使，賜金器幣、溧陽田三十頃。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Xia Gui was appointed Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army, Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, prefect of Huaian and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Huaidong Pacification Commission and Commissioner for Reconnaissance of Jingdong, and was granted gold vessels, silk, and thirty qing of fields at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Xia Gui was made Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army, Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, prefect of Huaian with concurrent duties as Vice Commissioner of the Huaidong Pacification Commission and Commissioner for Reconnaissance of Jingdong, and was granted gold vessels, silk, and thirty qing of land at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，進馬光祖資政殿大學士，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On renxu, Ma Guangzu was advanced to Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, his duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ma Guangzu was promoted to Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以呂文德兼夔路策應使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Lü Wende was ordered to serve concurrently as Coordinator for the Kuizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lü Wende was ordered to serve concurrently as coordinator for the Kuizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命馬光祖兼淮西總領財賦。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Ma Guangzu was ordered to serve concurrently as Overall Fiscal Intendant of Huaidong West.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Ma Guangzu was ordered to serve concurrently as overall fiscal intendant of Huaidong West.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，詔趙葵依舊少保、兩淮宣撫使、判揚州，進封魯國公；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuchen the new moon day, an edict ordered Zhao Kui to remain Junior Guardian, Commissioner for the Two Huai Pacification, and administrator of Yangzhou, and he was enfeoffed as Duke of Lu;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon, wuchen, an edict confirmed Zhao Kui as Junior Guardian, Commissioner for the Two Huai Pacification, and administrator of Yangzhou, and enfeoffed him as Duke of Lu;

sentences.zh: 徐清叟觀文殿大學士、知建寧府。

translations.literal: Xu Qingsou was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qingsou was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Jianning.

sentences.zh: 饒虎臣罷。

translations.literal: Rao Huchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Rao Huchen was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李曾伯、史岩之並落職解官，曾伯坐嶺南閉城自守，不能備禦；

translations.literal: On renshen, Li Zengbo and Shi Yanzhi were both stripped of office and dismissed; Zengbo was charged with closing the gates and holding himself in Lingnan without being able to prepare defenses;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Li Zengbo and Shi Yanzhi were both stripped of rank and dismissed; Zengbo was charged with shutting himself inside Lingnan without preparing adequate defenses;

sentences.zh: 岩之坐鄂州圍解，大元兵已渡江北還，然後出兵，又命程芾任事，以致敗績。

translations.literal: Yanzhi was charged with the siege of Ezhou being lifted only after Great Yuan troops had crossed the river north and returned before he sent out troops, and with appointing Cheng Fei to duties that led to defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhi was charged with waiting until after the Great Yuan forces had crossed the Yangzi north and withdrawn before sending troops out from the relieved siege of Ezhou, and with assigning Cheng Fei duties that had led to defeat.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔贈呂文信寧遠軍承宣使，立廟賜額，子師憲帶行閣職，更與兩子承信郎；

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict posthumously made Lü Wenxin Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningyuan Army, erected a temple and granted it a plaque; his son Shixian was given acting palace office, and two more sons were made Gentlemen for Trustworthiness;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict posthumously made Lü Wenxin Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningyuan Army, erected a temple with an imperial plaque, gave his son Shixian an acting palace appointment, and appointed two more sons Gentlemen for Trustworthiness;

sentences.zh: 輔周和州防禦使，錄其白鹿磯死事。

translations.literal: Fu Zhou was made Commissioner of Defense of Hezhou, recording his death in service at Bailu Jetty.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhou was made Commissioner of Defense of Hezhou in recognition of his death in service at Bailu Jetty.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔李虎馭軍無律，貸命追奪、竄郁林州。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict stated that Li Hu had commanded troops without discipline; his life was spared but his honors were stripped and he was banished to Yulin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, an edict declared that Li Hu had led troops without discipline; his life was spared but his honors were stripped and he was banished to Yulin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賜賈似道玉帶。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Jia Sidao was granted a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Jia Sidao was granted a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，戴慶炣卒，贈資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Dai Qingci died and was posthumously made Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Dai Qingci died and was posthumously made Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，熒惑犯鬥。

translations.literal: On renwu, Mars transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Mars transgressed the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以皮龍榮兼權參知政事；

translations.literal: On guiwei, Pi Longrong was ordered to serve concurrently as Acting Vice Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Pi Longrong was ordered to serve concurrently as acting Vice Grand Councillor;

sentences.zh: 沈炎端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事；

translations.literal: Shen Yan was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and Concurrent Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yan was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and concurrent signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 馬堃鄂州都統制，駐紮江陵府。

translations.literal: Ma Kun was made Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou and stationed at Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Kun was made Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou and stationed at Jiangling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祈雨。

translations.literal: On jiashen, prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔饒虎臣以資政殿學士提舉臨安府洞霄宮、任便居住。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict made Rao Huchen Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy and charged him with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an edict made Rao Huchen Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, assigned him to superintend the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, and permitted him to reside where he wished.

sentences.zh: 楊棟召赴闕。

translations.literal: Yang Dong was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Dong was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以姚希得爲敷文閣待制、知慶元府兼沿海制置使。

translations.literal: On renchen, Yao Xide was appointed Awaiting Draftsman of the Fuwen Pavilion, prefect of Qingyuan, and concurrently Coastal Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yao Xide was made Awaiting Draftsman of the Fuwen Pavilion, prefect of Qingyuan, and concurrently Coastal Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔李庭芝起復秘閣修撰、主管兩淮安撫制置司公事兼知楊州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict recalled Li Tingzhi from mourning to Compiler of the Secret Pavilion, charged with the affairs of the Two Huai Pacification and Defense Commission, and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, an edict recalled Li Tingzhi from mourning as Compiler of the Secret Pavilion, placed him in charge of the Two Huai Pacification and Defense Commission, and made him concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉朔，夏貴奏淮安戰功。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou the new moon day, Xia Gui memorialized his achievements at the battle of Huaian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon, dingyou, Xia Gui reported his victories at Huaian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，竄丁大全于南康軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Ding Daquan was banished to Nankang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Ding Daquan was banished to Nankang Army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔立皇子忠王禥爲皇太子，賜字長源。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict established the imperial son, Prince Zhong Qi, as crown prince and granted him the style Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict established Prince Zhong Qi as crown prince and granted him the style Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王野卒。

translations.literal: On wushen, Wang Ye died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wang Ye died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜李遇龍金帶。

translations.literal: On renzi, Li Yulong was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Li Yulong was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 陳奕帶御器械，依舊鎮江駐紮御前諸軍都統制，賜田三十頃。

translations.literal: Chen Yi was made Bearer of Imperial Arms, remaining as before Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Front Armies stationed at Zhenjiang, and was granted thirty qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yi was made Bearer of Imperial Arms, retained as Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Front Armies stationed at Zhenjiang, and granted thirty qing of land.

sentences.zh: 詔升巢縣爲鎮巢軍。

translations.literal: An edict elevated Chao County to Zhenchao Army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict elevated Chao County to the status of Zhenchao Army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楊棟、葉夢鼎並太子詹事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yang Dong and Ye Mengding were both made Mentors of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Dong and Ye Mengding were both appointed Mentors of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陳韡進一秩、福建安撫使、知福州，徐清叟觀文殿學士、知泉州。

translations.literal: On yimao, Chen Wei advanced one rank and was made Commissioner of the Fujian Pacification Commission and prefect of Fuzhou; Xu Qingsou was made Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Chen Wei advanced one rank and was made Commissioner of the Fujian Pacification Commission and prefect of Fuzhou; Xu Qingsou was made Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯朔，皇太子入東宮，行冊禮，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingmao the new moon day, the crown prince entered the Eastern Palace, the investiture ceremony was performed, and a general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the new moon, dingmao, the crown prince entered the Eastern Palace, the investiture ceremony was performed, and a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貴妃閻氏薨，賜諡惠昭。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Honored Consort, Lady Yan, died and was granted the posthumous title Kind and Illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Honored Consort Lady Yan died and was given the posthumous title Kind and Illustrious.

sentences.zh: 東南有星如太白。

translations.literal: In the southeast there was a star like Venus.
translations.idiomatic: A star as bright as Venus appeared in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命皇太子昕朝侍立。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the crown prince was ordered to attend court and stand in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the crown prince was ordered to attend court and stand in attendance at audience.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上謂宰執曰：「北朝使來，事體當議。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the emperor said to the chief ministers: "An envoy from the northern court has come; the matter should be deliberated."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the emperor told his chief ministers, "An envoy from the northern court has arrived; the matter must be deliberated."

sentences.zh: 」賈似道奏：「和出彼謀，豈容一切輕徇？

translations.literal: Jia Sidao memorialized: "Peace is their stratagem—how can we lightly comply in every respect?"
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao replied, "Peace is their stratagem—how can we lightly yield to them in every respect?"

sentences.zh: 倘以交鄰國之道來，當令入見。

translations.literal: If they come in the manner of a neighboring state, they should be ordered to have an audience.
translations.idiomatic: If they come as envoys of a neighboring state, they should be granted an audience.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，侍御史何夢然劾丁大全、吳潛欺君無君之罪。

translations.literal: On jichou, Remonstrating Censor He Mengran impeached Ding Daquan and Wu Qian for the crime of deceiving the ruler and acting as though there were no ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Remonstrating Censor He Mengran impeached Ding Daquan and Wu Qian for deceiving the throne and behaving as though there were no sovereign.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賈似道兼太子少師，朱熠、皮龍榮、沈炎並兼賓客。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jia Sidao was ordered to serve concurrently as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Zhu Yi, Pi Longrong, and Shen Yan were all ordered to serve concurrently as Guests of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jia Sidao was made concurrent Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Zhu Yi, Pi Longrong, and Shen Yan were all made concurrent Guests of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔丁大全削三秩、謫居南安軍，吳潛奪觀文殿大學士，罷祠，削二秩、謫居建昌軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict demoted Ding Daquan three ranks and banished him to Nan'an Army; Wu Qian was stripped of Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, dismissed from his temple charge, demoted two ranks, and banished to Jianchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict demoted Ding Daquan three ranks and banished him to Nan'an Army; Wu Qian was stripped of his grand academician title, dismissed from his temple appointment, demoted two ranks, and banished to Jianchang Army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔舉孝廉。

translations.literal: On guisi, an edict called for recommendations of filial and incorrupt candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, an edict called for the recommendation of filial and incorrupt candidates.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以程元鳳爲淮、浙發運使、判平江府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renyin, Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed Transport Commissioner for Huai and Zhe and administrator of Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Cheng Yuanfeng was made Transport Commissioner for Huai and Zhe and administrator of Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太子受冊畢，賈似道、朱熠、皮龍榮、沈炎各進一秩，東宮官吏諸軍兵等官一轉，餘皆推恩。

translations.literal: An edict stated that after the crown prince had completed receiving the investiture, Jia Sidao, Zhu Yi, Pi Longrong, and Shen Yan each advanced one rank; Eastern Palace officials, various army soldiers, and the like each advanced one rank; the rest received extended favors.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that after the crown prince's investiture, Jia Sidao, Zhu Yi, Pi Longrong, and Shen Yan each advanced one rank; Eastern Palace officials and troops each advanced one rank; and extended favors were granted to the rest.

sentences.zh: 壬子，與芮薨，贈少師，諡忠憲。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yu Rui died and was posthumously made Junior Preceptor, with the posthumous title Loyal and Lawful.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yu Rui died and was posthumously made Junior Preceptor with the posthumous title Loyal and Lawful.

sentences.zh: 太白犯房。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed the Chamber [asterism].
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Chamber asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，李曾伯、史岩之各削二秩。

translations.literal: On renxu, Li Zengbo and Shi Yanzhi were each demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Li Zengbo and Shi Yanzhi were each demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，饒虎臣削二秩，奪資政殿學士，罷祠。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Rao Huchen was demoted two ranks, stripped of Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, and dismissed from his temple charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Rao Huchen was demoted two ranks, stripped of his academician title, and dismissed from his temple appointment.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，守瀘州劉整以功來上。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiyou, Liu Zheng, defender of Luzhou, reported merit to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou, Liu Zheng, defender of Luzhou, presented a report of his achievements to the throne.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，知漳州、節制屯戍軍馬洪天錫言，援例創辟幹官一員，報行軍機密文字，奏可。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Hong Tiansi, prefect of Zhang Prefecture and commander of garrison troops, stated that following precedent a staff officer should be newly appointed to relay military secret documents; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Hong Tiansi, prefect of Zhangzhou and commander of garrison troops, petitioned that, following precedent, a staff officer be newly appointed to relay classified military documents; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，熒惑犯壁。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Mars transgressed the Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Mars transgressed the Wall asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李松壽犯淮安。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Li Songshou attacked Huaian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Li Songshou attacked Huaian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未朔，詔申嚴邊防。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yimei the new moon day, an edict ordered strict enforcement of border defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon, yimei, an edict ordered strict enforcement of border defenses.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔党丁大全、吳潛者，台諫其嚴覺察舉劾以聞，當置於罪，以爲同惡相濟者之戒。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict stated: "Those who consorted with Ding Daquan and Wu Qian—office censors and remonstrators are to strictly investigate, impeach, and report; they are to be punished as a warning to those who aid the wicked in concert."
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an edict declared that those who had consorted with Ding Daquan and Wu Qian were to be rigorously investigated and impeached by the censorate and remonstrance officials, punished accordingly, and held up as a warning to anyone who conspired with the wicked.

sentences.zh: 時似道專政，台諫何夢然、孫附鳳、桂錫孫、劉應龍承順風指，凡爲似道所惡者無賢否皆斥，帝弗悟其奸，爲下是詔。

translations.literal: At this time Jia Sidao monopolized government; Censor-Remonstrators He Mengran, Sun Fufeng, Gui Xisun, and Liu Yinglong followed his wind and cues; all whom Sidao hated, regardless of merit, were dismissed; the emperor did not perceive his treachery and issued this edict.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Jia Sidao held sole power; the censor-remonstrators He Mengran, Sun Fufeng, Gui Xisun, and Liu Yinglong followed his lead; everyone Sidao disliked, whether worthy or not, was dismissed; the emperor did not see through his treachery and issued this edict.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李松壽修南城，詔趣淮閫調兵毀之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Li Songshou repaired the southern city; an edict urged the Huai strategic commissioner to deploy troops and destroy it.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Li Songshou repaired the southern city; an edict ordered the Huai strategic commander to dispatch troops and destroy it.

sentences.zh: 壬子，破李松壽兵于漣水城下，夷南城舊址。

translations.literal: On renzi, Li Songshou's army was defeated below Lianshui city and the old site of the southern city was leveled.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Li Songshou's forces were defeated below Lianshui and the old site of the southern city was razed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，有星自東北急流向太陰。

translations.literal: On yimao, a star rushed swiftly from the northeast toward the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a star was seen rushing from the northeast toward the moon.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，竄吳潛於潮州。

translations.literal: On renxu, Wu Qian was banished to Chao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wu Qian was exiled to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，詔內侍何時修削二秩，永罷不敘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingyin, an edict demoted the eunuch He Shixiu two ranks and forever barred him from reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin, an edict demoted the eunuch He Shixiu two ranks and permanently barred him from office.

sentences.zh: 洪燾知臨安府兼浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: Hong Tao was appointed prefect of Lin'an and concurrently Commissioner of the Western Zhejiang Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Tao was made prefect of Lin'an and concurrently Western Zhejiang Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以中軍統制、知簡州馬千權興州都統兼知合州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Ma Qian, commander of the central army and prefect of Jian Prefecture, was appointed acting commander-in-chief of Xing Prefecture and concurrently prefect of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Ma Qian, central-army commander and prefect of Jianzhou, was appointed acting commander-in-chief of Xingzhou and concurrently prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，熒惑與填星順行，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Mars and Saturn moved in direct motion; the moon transgressed the Chamber asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Mars and Saturn moved in direct motion, and the moon transgressed the Chamber asterism.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午朔，詔華亭奉宸莊，其隸外廷助軍餉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiawu the new moon day, an edict placed the Fengchen Estate at Huating under the outer court to assist military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon, jiawu, an edict placed the Fengchen Estate at Huating under the outer court to help supply the army.

sentences.zh: 包恢敘復元官職、知常州。

translations.literal: Bao Hui was restored to his original office and made prefect of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Hui was restored to his former rank and appointed prefect of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，建陽縣嘉禾生，一本十五穗，詔改建陽爲嘉禾縣。

translations.literal: On xinchou, in Jianyang County a propitious grain stalk grew with fifteen ears on one stalk; an edict renamed Jianyang as Jiahe County.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a propitious grain stalk with fifteen ears on one plant appeared in Jianyang County; an edict renamed the county Jiahe.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，呂文德上夔路戰功。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Lü Wende submitted the battle achievements of the Kuizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lü Wende submitted a report of military achievements in the Kuizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，少師、廬陵郡王思正薨，諡簡惠。

translations.literal: On yimao, Junior Preceptor and Prince of Luling Wang Sizheng died; his posthumous title was Simple and Kind.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Junior Preceptor Wang Sizheng, Prince of Luling, died; he was given the posthumous title Simple and Kind.

sentences.zh: 印應雷直徽猷閣、知江州、主管江西安撫司公事，節制蘄、黃、興國三郡。

translations.literal: Yin Yinglei was made Direct Attendant of the Hall of Imperial Instruction, prefect of Jiang Prefecture, administrator of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and commander of Qi, Huang, and Xingguo prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Yinglei was appointed Direct Attendant of the Hall of Imperial Instruction, prefect of Jiangzhou, administrator of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and commander of the three prefectures of Qizhou, Huangzhou, and Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以監察御史桂錫孫言，追寢全子才敘復之命。

translations.literal: On gengshen, on the statement of Supervising Censor Gui Xisun, the order restoring Quan Zicai was traced back and withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, on Supervising Censor Gui Xisun's memorial, the order restoring Quan Zicai was revoked.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥朔，詔：「監司率半歲具劾去贓吏之數來上，視多寡爲殿最，行賞罰。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month of spring, on guihai the new moon day, an edict stated: "Circuit intendants are to submit half-yearly the number of corrupt officials impeached and removed, and rewards and punishments are to be applied according to whether the numbers are high or low in ranking."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, guihai, an edict stated: "Circuit intendants are to submit half-yearly reports of the corrupt officials they have impeached and removed; rankings and rewards or punishments are to be assessed according to the numbers."

sentences.zh: 守臣助監司所不及，以一歲爲殿最，定賞罰。

translations.literal: Prefectural officials are to assist where circuit intendants fall short; yearly rankings determine rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural officials are to assist where circuit intendants fall short, with yearly rankings determining rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 本路、州無所劾，而台諫論列，則監司守臣皆以殿定罰。

translations.literal: If within a circuit or prefecture no one is impeached, yet censor-remonstrators raise charges, then both circuit intendants and prefectural officials are to be ranked last and punished.
translations.idiomatic: If a circuit or prefecture impeaches no one but censor-remonstrators raise charges, then both circuit intendants and prefectural officials are to be ranked last and punished.

sentences.zh: 有治狀廉聲者，摭實以聞。

translations.literal: Those with records of good governance and reputation for integrity are to be reported with substantiation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials with records of good governance and reputations for integrity are to be reported to the throne with substantiating facts.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，城安慶。

translations.literal: On yichou, Anqing was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, fortifications were built at Anqing.

sentences.zh: 詔馬光祖進二秩。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Ma Guangzu two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Ma Guangzu two ranks in office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命皇太子謁拜孔子於太學。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the crown prince was ordered to pay respects to Confucius at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the crown prince was ordered to pay homage to Confucius at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 己卯，福建安撫使陳韡累疏請老，詔進一秩，守觀文殿學士致仕。

translations.literal: On jimao, Fujian Pacification Commissioner Chen Wei repeatedly memorialized requesting retirement; an edict advanced him one rank and made him Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Fujian Pacification Commissioner Chen Wei repeatedly petitioned to retire; an edict advanced him one rank and granted him retirement as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.

sentences.zh: 以董槐判福州、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: Dong Huai was made acting prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Huai was appointed acting prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔封張栻爲華陽伯，呂祖謙開封伯，從祀孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict enfeoffed Zhang Shi as Baron of Huayang and Lü Zuqian as Baron of Kaifeng, to receive associated sacrifice in the Confucian temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, an edict enfeoffed Zhang Shi as Baron of Huayang and Lü Zuqian as Baron of Kaifeng, granting them associated places in the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，孫虎臣戰邳州，全師而歸。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingshen, Sun Huchen fought at Pi Prefecture and returned with the whole army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen, Sun Huchen fought at Pizhou and returned with his entire army intact.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔諸路監司申嚴偽會賞罰之令。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict ordered all circuit intendants strictly to enforce the regulations on spurious assemblies and rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, an edict ordered circuit intendants throughout the empire strictly to enforce regulations against sham assemblies and on rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，進封周國公主。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Princess Zhou was advanced in enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Princess Zhou was advanced in rank of enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renxu the new moon day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon, renxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，故寧遠軍承宣使張祥、都統制閻忠進，以援蜀之功，祥贈節度使，忠進贈復州團練。

translations.literal: On yihai, the late Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningyuan Army Zhang Xiang and Commander-in-Chief Yan Zhongjin, for their achievements in aiding Sichuan—Xiang was posthumously made military commissioner; Zhongjin was posthumously made regiment trainer of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the late Commissioner-in-Chief of the Ningyuan Army Zhang Xiang and Commander-in-Chief Yan Zhongjin, for their achievements in aiding Sichuan, were posthumously honored—Xiang as military commissioner and Zhongjin as regiment trainer of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 除恩澤外，各更官一子承信郎，賜緡錢二萬。

translations.literal: Apart from favor appointments, one son of each was further appointed Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and twenty thousand strings of cash were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In addition to favor appointments, one son of each was further appointed Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and each was granted twenty thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賈似道等上《玉牒》、《日曆》、《會要》、《經武要略》及孝宗、光宗、寧宗《實錄》，詔似道、皮龍榮、朱熠、沈炎各進二秩。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Jia Sidao and others submitted the Jade Register, Daily Calendar, Compendium of Institutions, Essentials of Military Affairs, and the Veritable Records of Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong; an edict advanced Sidao, Pi Longrong, Zhu Yi, and Shen Yan each two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jia Sidao and others submitted the Jade Register, Daily Calendar, Compendium of Institutions, Essentials of Military Affairs, and the Veritable Records of Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong; an edict advanced Sidao, Pi Longrong, Zhu Yi, and Shen Yan each two ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，餘思忠追毀出身文字，除名勒停、竄新州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi the new moon day, Yu Sizhong had his credentials of appointment traced and destroyed, was expelled from the rolls and suspended, and banished to Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon, guisi, Yu Sizhong had his appointment documents revoked, was expelled from office, and was banished to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以皮龍榮參知政事，沈炎同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，何夢然簽書樞密院事，俞興保康軍承宣使、四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Pi Longrong was made Vice Grand Councillor; Shen Yan vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting Vice Grand Councillor; He Mengran signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Xing Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Pi Longrong was made Vice Grand Councillor; Shen Yan vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting Vice Grand Councillor; He Mengran signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Yu Xing Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，呂文德超授太尉、京湖安撫制置屯田使、夔路策應使兼知鄂州，李庭芝右文殿修撰、樞密都承旨、兩淮安撫制置副使、知揚州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Lü Wende was extraordinarily appointed Grand Marshal, Jing-Hu Pacification and Military Colonies Commissioner, Kuizhou Circuit Coordinator, and concurrently prefect of E Prefecture; Li Tingzhi Compiler of the Youwen Hall, Privy Council chief receptionist, Vice Commissioner of the Two Huai Pacification Commission, and prefect of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Lü Wende was extraordinarily appointed Grand Marshal, Jing-Hu Pacification and Military Colonies Commissioner, Kuizhou Circuit Coordinator, and concurrently prefect of Ezhou; Li Tingzhi was made Compiler of the Youwen Hall, Privy Council chief receptionist, Vice Commissioner of the Two Huai Pacification Commission, and prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔申嚴江防。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict ordered strict enforcement of Yangtze defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, an edict ordered strict enforcement of Yangtze River defenses.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，呂文德兼湖廣總領財賦。

translations.literal: On renyin, Lü Wende was additionally appointed Overall Fiscal Intendant of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Lü Wende was additionally appointed Overall Fiscal Intendant of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，馬天驥資政殿學士、知福州、福建安撫使，呂文福帶御器械、淮西安撫副使兼知廬州，官一轉。

translations.literal: On yisi, Ma Tianji was made Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian Pacification Commissioner; Lü Wenfu Bearer of Imperial Arms, Vice Commissioner of Huai West Pacification Commission and concurrently prefect of Lu Prefecture—with one rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Ma Tianji was made Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian Pacification Commissioner; Lü Wenfu was made Bearer of Imperial Arms, Vice Commissioner of Huai West Pacification, and concurrently prefect of Luzhou, each advancing one rank.

sentences.zh: 戊申，馬光祖進觀文殿學士，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On wushen, Ma Guangzu was advanced to Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, his duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Ma Guangzu was advanced to Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, with his duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，竄吳潛於循州。

translations.literal: On yimao, Wu Qian was banished to Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wu Qian was exiled to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，竄丁大全於貴州，追削二秩。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Ding Daquan was banished to Gui Prefecture and retroactively stripped of two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Ding Daquan was exiled to Guizhou and retroactively demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊鎮授左領軍衛將軍、駙馬都尉，高達知廬州、淮西安撫副使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yang Zhen was appointed General of the Left Leading Army Guard and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant; Gao Da was made prefect of Lu Prefecture and Vice Commissioner of Huai West Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yang Zhen was appointed General of the Left Leading Army Guard and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant; Gao Da was made prefect of Luzhou and Vice Commissioner of Huai West Pacification.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，賈似道請祠祿，詔不允。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guihai, Jia Sidao requested a stipend for a sinecure temple post; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai, Jia Sidao requested a temple stipend; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 庚午，謝方叔敘復觀文殿大學士致仕。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xie Fangshu was restored to the status of retired Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xie Fangshu was restored to retirement as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以劉雄飛知夔州、夔路安撫使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Liu Xiongfei was made prefect of Kui Prefecture and Kui Circuit Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Liu Xiongfei was appointed prefect of Kuizhou and Kui Circuit Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，王堅遷左金吾衛上將軍、湖北安撫使兼知江陵府。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Wang Jian was transferred to Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, Hubei Pacification Commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wang Jian was transferred to Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, Hubei Pacification Commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，詔霖雨爲沴，避殿、減膳、徹樂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiwei, an edict noted prolonged rain as a calamity; the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiwei, an edict declared prolonged rain a calamity; the emperor left the main hall, reduced his meals, and suspended music.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔近畿水災，安吉爲甚，亟講行荒政。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict noted flooding in the capital vicinity, Anji suffering most severely; famine relief policies were urgently to be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict noted flooding in the capital vicinity, with Anji hardest hit, and ordered urgent implementation of famine relief policies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以範文虎爲左領軍衛大將軍，主管侍衛步軍司兼馬軍司。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Fan Wenhu was made Grand General of the Left Leading Army Guard and administrator of the Palace Step Army Department and Horse Army Department.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Fan Wenhu was appointed Grand General of the Left Leading Army Guard and put in charge of the Palace Step Army and Horse Army departments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，蜀帥俞興奏守瀘州劉整率所部兵北降，由興構隙致變也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, Sichuan commander Yu Xing memorialized that Liu Zheng, defender of Luzhou, had led his troops to surrender to the northern court—the change arose from Yu Xing's sowing discord.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, Sichuan commander Yu Xing reported that Liu Zheng, defender of Luzhou, had led his troops to defect to the northern court—a rupture Yu Xing himself had provoked by sowing discord.

sentences.zh: 至是，興移檄討整。

translations.literal: At this point Xing issued a proclamation to campaign against Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Yu Xing issued a proclamation to campaign against Liu Zheng.

sentences.zh: 辛未，制置使蒲擇之坐密通蠟書叛賊羅顯，詔竄萬安軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Pacification Commissioner Pu Zezhi was charged with secretly communicating by wax-sealed letter with the rebel Luo Xian; an edict banished him to Wan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Pacification Commissioner Pu Zezhi was charged with secretly communicating by sealed letter with the rebel Luo Xian; an edict exiled him to Wan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以厲文翁爲資政殿學士、沿海制置使、知慶元府。

translations.literal: On yihai, Li Weng was made Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, Coastal Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Weng was appointed Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, Coastal Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王惟忠家訟冤，詔奪謝方叔合得恩數。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Wang Weizhong family petitioned over a grievance; an edict stripped Xie Fangshu of honors due him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Wang Weizhong family petitioned over a grievance; an edict stripped Xie Fangshu of the honors due him.

sentences.zh: 丁大全責授新州團練使、貴州安置。

translations.literal: Ding Daquan was demoted and appointed Regiment Trainer of Xin Prefecture, assigned to reside at Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Daquan was demoted to Regiment Trainer of Xinzhou and assigned to reside at Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 台臣吳燧奪職罷祠，陳大方、胡大昌皆鐫官。

translations.literal: Censor Wu Sui was stripped of office and dismissed from his temple appointment; Chen Dafang and Hu Dachang were both reduced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wu Sui was stripped of office and dismissed from his temple appointment; Chen Dafang and Hu Dachang were both demoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 壬午．陳韡卒，贈少師，諡忠肅。

translations.literal: On renwu, Chen Wei died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Loyal and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Chen Wei died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Loyal and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吳潛責授化州團練使、循州安置。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Wu Qian was demoted and appointed Regiment Trainer of Hua Prefecture, assigned to reside at Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wu Qian was demoted to Regiment Trainer of Huazhou and assigned to reside at Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，命韓宣兼常德、辰、沅、澧、靖五郡鎮撫使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renchen, Han Xuan was ordered to serve concurrently as Pacification Commissioner of the five prefectures Changde, Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, Han Xuan was ordered to serve concurrently as Pacification Commissioner of Changde and the four prefectures of Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing.

sentences.zh: 呂文德兼四川宣撫使，範文虎以白鹿磯之功賞七官，以五官轉行遙郡防禦使，餘官給憑。

translations.literal: Lü Wende was additionally Sichuan Grand Pacification Commissioner; Fan Wenhu, for his achievement at Bailu Jetty, was rewarded seven ranks, with five ranks converted to acting distant-prefecture defense commissioner; the remaining ranks were granted credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende was additionally appointed Sichuan Grand Pacification Commissioner; Fan Wenhu, for his achievement at Bailu Jetty, was rewarded seven ranks, with five converted to acting distant-prefecture defense commissioner; credentials were issued for his remaining ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔奪向士璧從官恩數，窮竟侵盜掩匿之罪。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict stripped Xiang Shibi of honors attendant on office and fully investigated charges of embezzlement and concealment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, an edict stripped Xiang Shibi of the honors due his rank and ordered a full investigation of charges of embezzlement and concealment.

sentences.zh: 時以兵退，遣官會計邊費，似道忌功，欲以汙篾一時閫臣，士璧及趙葵、史岩之、杜庶皆責征償。

translations.literal: At this time, as troops had withdrawn, officials were dispatched to audit border expenses; Sidao, jealous of merit, wished to smear the strategic commanders of the day—Shibi, Zhao Kui, Shi Yanzhi, and Du Shu were all ordered to pay restitution.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, with troops withdrawn, officials were dispatched to audit border expenses; Sidao, jealous of others' achievements, sought to tarnish the strategic commanders of the day—Shibi, Zhao Kui, Shi Yanzhi, and Du Shu were all ordered to make restitution.

sentences.zh: 信州謝枋得以趙葵檄給錢粟募民兵守禦，至是，自償萬緡。

translations.literal: Xie Fangde of Xin Prefecture, on Zhao Kui's order, supplied money and grain to recruit militia for defense; at this point he personally paid restitution of ten thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Fangde of Xinzhou, acting on Zhao Kui's order to supply money and grain to recruit militia for defense, now personally paid restitution of ten thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，築周國公主館于安濟橋。

translations.literal: On renyin, a residence for Princess Zhou was built at Anji Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a residence for Princess Zhou was built at Anji Bridge.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以江萬里爲端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事，依執政恩數。

translations.literal: On yisi, Jiang Wanli was made Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with honors according to chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Jiang Wanli was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with honors equal to those of chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，詔湖、秀二郡水災，守令其亟勸分，監司申嚴荒政。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinyou, an edict noted flooding in Hu and Xiu prefectures; prefectural officials were urgently to encourage sharing, and circuit intendants strictly to enforce famine relief policies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, an edict noted flooding in Hu and Xiu prefectures and ordered prefectural officials urgently to encourage grain sharing while circuit intendants strictly enforced famine relief policies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李庭芝言李松壽已遁。

translations.literal: On yihai, Li Tingzhi reported that Li Songshou had already fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Tingzhi reported that Li Songshou had already fled.

sentences.zh: 大元使赦經久留真州，帝趣與錫賚。

translations.literal: The Great Yuan envoy He Jing had long remained at Zhen Prefecture; the emperor urgently ordered gifts and rewards granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Yuan envoy He Jing had long remained at Zhenzhou; the emperor urgently ordered that gifts and rewards be granted to him.

sentences.zh: 經之留，謀出賈似道，帝惑其言不悟。

translations.literal: Jing's detention was a scheme of Jia Sidao; the emperor was misled by his words and did not perceive the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's detention was Jia Sidao's doing; the emperor was misled by Sidao's words and did not see the truth.

sentences.zh: 蓋似道在鄂時，值我世祖皇帝歸正大位撤兵，似道自詭有再造之功，諱言歲幣及講和之事，故不使經入見。

translations.literal: For when Sidao was at E, our Founding Emperor returned to the orthodox throne and withdrew troops; Sidao falsely claimed credit for restoring the dynasty, avoided mention of annual tribute and peace talks, and therefore did not allow Jing to enter audience.
translations.idiomatic: For when Sidao was at Ezhou, our Founding Emperor had returned to the orthodox throne and withdrawn his troops; Sidao falsely claimed credit for restoring the dynasty, avoided mention of annual tribute and peace negotiations, and therefore did not allow Jing to be received in audience.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，呂文德言已復瀘州外堡，擬即對江壘石爲城，以示持久之計，從之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, Lü Wende reported that the outer fort of Luzhou had been recovered and proposed immediately to pile stone across the river as a city to show a plan for endurance; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, Lü Wende reported that Luzhou's outer fort had been recovered and proposed immediately building a stone city on the opposite bank to show a plan for holding the ground long term; the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雷電。

translations.literal: On wuxu, thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu there was thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔申獎賈似道鄂州之功。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict again commended Jia Sidao's achievements at E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, an edict again commended Jia Sidao's achievements at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以何夢然同知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingwu, He Mengran was made vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, He Mengran was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，程元鳳授特進、觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On guichou, Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed Special Advancement, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and concurrently Lecturer-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed Special Advancement, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and concurrently Lecturer-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，皇太子擇配，帝詔其母族全昭孫之女擇日入見。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the crown prince chose a consort; the emperor ordered the daughter of Quan Zaosun of his mother's clan to choose a day to enter audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, as the crown prince chose a consort, the emperor ordered the daughter of Quan Zaosun of his mother's clan to choose a day to be presented at court.

sentences.zh: 寶祐中，昭孫沒于王事，全氏見上，上曰：「爾父死可念。

translations.literal: During the Baoyou era, Zaosun died in the state's service; the Quan lady had audience with the emperor, who said: "Your father's death is to be mourned.
translations.idiomatic: During the Baoyou era, Zaosun died in the state's service; when Lady Quan was presented to the emperor, he said, "Your father's death is lamentable.

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「臣妾父固可念，淮、湖百姓尤可念。

translations.literal: She replied: "Your servant's father is indeed to be mourned, but the people of Huai and the lakes are still more to be mourned.
translations.idiomatic: She replied, "My father's death is indeed lamentable, but the people of the Huai region and the lakes are far more so.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「即此語可母天下。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "With words like these she can mother all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "With words like these she can mother the empire.

sentences.zh: 」迨開慶丁大全用事，以京尹顧嵓女爲議，大全敗，故有是命。

translations.literal: When in Ka Qing Ding Daquan held power, the capital intendant Gu Yan's daughter had been proposed; when Daquan fell, this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: During Ka Qing, when Ding Daquan held power, Capital Intendant Gu Yan's daughter had been proposed; after Daquan fell, this order was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，沈炎資政殿學士、提舉臨安府洞霄宮、任便居住。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Shen Yan was made Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Shen Yan was made Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to reside where he wished.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，劉雄飛和州防禦使、樞密副都承旨、四川安撫制置副使兼知重慶府、四川總領、夔路轉運使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiwei the new moon day, Liu Xiongfei was made Defense Commissioner of He Prefecture, Associate Privy Council chief receptionist, Vice Commissioner of the Sichuan Pacification Commission and concurrently prefect of Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan Overall Fiscal Intendant, and Kuizhou Circuit Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon, jiwei, Liu Xiongfei was made Defense Commissioner of Hezhou, Associate Privy Council chief receptionist, Vice Commissioner of the Sichuan Pacification Commission and concurrently prefect of Chongqing, Sichuan Overall Fiscal Intendant, and Kuizhou Circuit Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，周國公主館成，詔董宋臣、李忠輔各官一轉。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Princess Zhou's residence was completed; an edict advanced Dong Songchen and Li Zhongfu each one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Princess Zhou's residence was completed; an edict advanced Dong Songchen and Li Zhongfu each one rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，資政殿學士致仕汝騰卒，贈官四轉，諡忠清。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the retired Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy Ru Teng died; four ranks were posthumously granted and his posthumous title was Loyal and Pure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the retired Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy Ru Teng died; he was posthumously granted four ranks and given the posthumous title Loyal and Pure.

sentences.zh: 安南國貢象二。

translations.literal: Annan sent tribute of two elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Annam presented tribute of two elephants.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馬光祖提領戶部財用兼知臨安府、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Ma Guangzu was made Overall Intendant of Revenue in the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently prefect of Lin'an and Commissioner of the Western Zhejiang Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Ma Guangzu was appointed Overall Intendant of Revenue in the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently prefect of Lin'an and Western Zhejiang Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 下嫁周國公主于楊鎮。

translations.literal: Princess Zhou was given in marriage to Yang Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Zhou was given in marriage to Yang Zhen.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以鎮爲宜州觀察使，賜玉帶，尋升慶遠軍承宣使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Zhen was made Observation Commissioner of Yi Prefecture and granted a jade belt; soon he was advanced to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yang Zhen was made Observation Commissioner of Yizhou and granted a jade belt; soon he was advanced to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 詔：「駙馬都尉楊鎮家合有賞典，楊蕃孫官兩轉，楊鐸、楊鑒官一轉，並直秘閣，餘轉官進封有差。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Yang Zhen's family is due reward precedents; Yang Fansun advances two ranks; Yang Duo and Yang Jian advance one rank each, all made Direct Attendants of the Secretariat Pavilion; the rest receive differing rank advancements and enfeoffments."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Yang Zhen's family is due customary rewards; Yang Fansun is to advance two ranks; Yang Duo and Yang Jiang one rank each, all to be made Direct Attendants of the Secretariat Pavilion; the rest are to receive differing advancements in rank and enfeoffment."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，封全氏永嘉郡夫人。

translations.literal: On guwei, Lady Quan was enfeoffed as Lady of Yongjia Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei, Lady Quan was enfeoffed as Lady of Yongjia Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，改竄蒲擇之于南康軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Pu Zezhi's place of banishment was changed to Nankang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Pu Zezhi's place of exile was changed to Nankang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宰臣奏：「太子語臣等言：'近奉聖訓，夫婦之道，王化之基，男女正位，天地大義。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the grand councillors memorialized: "The crown prince told us ministers, 'Having recently received the sage instruction, the way of husband and wife is the foundation of kingly transformation; proper station for men and women is the great principle of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the grand councillors reported that the crown prince had told them, "Having recently received the emperor's instruction, the way of husband and wife is the foundation of civilizing rule; the proper stations of men and women embody the great principle of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 平日所講修身齊家之道，當真履實踐，勿爲口耳之學。

translations.literal: The teaching on cultivating the self and ordering the family that is normally expounded ought to be truly practiced in deed and not treated as learning merely of mouth and ear.
translations.idiomatic: The doctrine of self-cultivation and household order that one normally teaches must be genuinely put into practice and not remain mere learning of the ears and mouth.

sentences.zh: '請宣付史館，永爲世程法。

translations.literal: I request that it be proclaimed and forwarded to the Historiography Office, to serve forever as a standard for the age.'"
translations.idiomatic: I ask that it be proclaimed and sent to the Historiography Office, to serve forever as a model for the world.'"

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以皮龍榮兼權知樞密院事，何夢然參知政事兼太子賓客，馬光祖同知樞密院事兼太子賓客、知臨安府。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Pi Longrong was ordered to serve concurrently as acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; He Mengran as Vice Grand Councillor and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent; Ma Guangzu as vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent, and prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Pi Longrong was made acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; He Mengran Vice Grand Councillor and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent; and Ma Guangzu vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent, and prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯五車。

translations.literal: On jihai, the moon transgressed the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the moon transgressed the constellation Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，江萬里依舊端明殿學士、提舉臨安府洞霄宮、任便居住。

translations.literal: On renyin, Jiang Wanli was restored as Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Jiang Wanli was restored as Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to live where he chose.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，冊永嘉郡夫人全氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: On guimao, Lady Quan, Lady of Yongjia Commandery, was invested as consort of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Lady Quan of Yongjia Commandery was invested as consort of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊子朔，詔申飭百官盡言。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the new moon, wuzi, an edict again charged all officials to speak fully.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on the new moon, wuzi, an edict again urged every official to speak without reserve.

sentences.zh: 詔量移丁大全、吳潛黨人，並永不錄用。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the transferred exile of partisans of Ding Daquan and Wu Qian, all to be never again recruited to office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the transferred exile of associates of Ding Daquan and Wu Qian, none of whom were ever to be employed again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔：「陳塏等耆年奉祠，宜示崇獎：陳塏端明殿學士，林彬之寶章閣待制，史季溫直華文閣，丁仁直寶謨閣，仍並予祠祿。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict stated: "Chen Kai and others, venerable in years and serving in temple posts, should be shown honorific rewards: Chen Kai, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance; Lin Binzhi, Attendant Drafting at the Hall of Precious Insignia; Shi Jiwen, Direct Attendant of the Sublime Literary Hall; Ding Ren, Direct Attendant of the Hall of Worthy Counsels—all still granted temple stipends."
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, an edict declared: "Chen Kai and others, elderly men in temple service, deserve honorific rewards: Chen Kai as Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance; Lin Binzhi as Attendant Drafting at the Hall of Precious Insignia; Shi Jiwen as Direct Attendant of the Sublime Literary Hall; and Ding Ren as Direct Attendant of the Hall of Worthy Counsels—all to retain their temple stipends."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，福建路安撫使馬天驥進資政殿大學士，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Ma Tianji, Fujian Circuit Pacification Commissioner, was advanced to Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy; his duties remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Ma Tianji, Pacification Commissioner of Fujian Circuit, was promoted to Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔諭西蜀郡縣等官，已授遇闕，毋遙受虛批月日，違期不赴。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict instructed officials of western Shu commanderies and counties: once appointed to a vacancy, they must not from afar accept empty approval dates in advance, nor fail to report by the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict instructed officials in western Shu commanderies and counties that, once appointed to a vacancy, they must not accept from afar empty approval dates in advance or fail to take up their posts by the deadline.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以善諮嗣濮王。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Shan Zi succeeded as Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Shan Zi succeeded to the title Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，周國公主進封周、漢國公主。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the Princess of Zhou State was further enfeoffed as Princess of Zhou and Han states.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Princess of Zhou was further enfeoffed as Princess of Zhou and Han.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜賈似道第宅於集芳園，給緡錢百萬，就建家廟。

translations.literal: On gengwu, a residence in the Jifang Garden was granted to Jia Sidao, with one million strings of cash supplied to build a family temple on the site.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Jia Sidao was granted a residence in the Jifang Garden, with one million strings of cash to build a family temple on the premises.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔權知梁山軍李鑒守城有功，帶行閣門宣贊舍人，就知梁山軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict noted that Li Jian, acting military prefect of Liangshan Army, had merit in defending the city; he was granted acting Herald of the Gate of Reception and concurrently appointed military prefect of Liangshan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict noted that Li Jian, acting prefect of Liangshan Army, had merit in holding the city; he was granted acting Herald of the Gate of Reception and appointed prefect of Liangshan Army.

sentences.zh: 復瀘州，改爲江安軍。

translations.literal: Luzhou was restored and redesignated as Jiang'an Army.
