translations.idiomatic: Luzhou was restored and renamed Jiang'an Army.

sentences.zh: 呂文德進開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Lü Wende was advanced to Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende was promoted to Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥朔，臨安、安吉、嘉興屬邑水，民溺死者衆，詔守臣給礻彗瘞之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon, dinghai, flooding struck subordinate districts of Lin'an, Anji, and Jiaxing; many people drowned; an edict ordered local officials to supply coffins and bury the dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon, dinghai, flooding struck districts under Lin'an, Anji, and Jiaxing and many people drowned; an edict ordered local officials to supply coffins and bury the dead.

sentences.zh: 詔獎諭制置司，其立功參贊將士，進秩、升職犒給有差。

translations.literal: An edict commended the strategic commissioner; officers and soldiers who had participated and achieved merit received differing advancements in rank, promotions, and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended the strategic commissioner, and participating officers and soldiers who had achieved merit received differing advancements in rank, promotions, and rewards.

sentences.zh: 乃裕授檢校少保。

translations.literal: Nai Yu was appointed acting Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Nai Yu was appointed acting Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 以皮龍榮爲資政殿大學士、知潭州、湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: Pi Longrong was made Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, prefect of Tan Prefecture, and Hunan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Longrong was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, prefect of Tanzhou, and Hunan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On yisi, the moon entered the House.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the moon entered the House constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔省試中選士人覆試于御史台，爲定制。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict ordered selected metropolitan examination candidates to undergo re-examination at the Censorate, establishing this as a permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict ordered candidates selected in the metropolitan examination to be re-examined at the Censorate, making this a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李璮以漣、海三城叛大元來歸，獻山東郡縣。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Li Tan, with the three cities of Lian and Hai, rebelled against the Great Yuan and came over to the Song, presenting Shandong commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Tan rebelled against the Great Yuan with the three cities of Lian and Hai and came over to the Song, presenting the commanderies and counties of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 詔改漣水爲安東州，授璮保信寧武軍節度使、督視京東河北等路軍馬、齊郡王，復其父李全官爵。

translations.literal: An edict redesignated Lianshui as Andong Prefecture, appointed Tan Military Commissioner of the Baoxin-Ningwu Army, Supervisor of military affairs in the circuits of eastern Capital, northern Hebei, and the like, and Prince of Qi Commandery, and restored the official rank and title of his father Li Quan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict redesignated Lianshui as Andong Prefecture, made Tan Military Commissioner of the Baoxin-Ningwu Army and Supervisor of military affairs on the eastern Capital, northern Hebei, and related routes, enfeoffed him as Prince of Qi Commandery, and restored the rank and title of his father Li Quan.

sentences.zh: 璮即松壽。

translations.literal: Tan is Songshou.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was Li Songshou.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，以孫附鳳爲端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yichou, Sun Fufeng was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Sun Fufeng was appointed Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔升海州東海縣爲東海軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict promoted Donghai County of Haizhou to Donghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict promoted Donghai County in Haizhou to Donghai Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，汪立信升直華文閣、知江州、主管江西安撫司公事，節制蘄、黃、興國三郡軍馬。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Wang Lixin was promoted to Direct Attendant of the Sublime Literary Hall, made prefect of Jiang Prefecture, put in charge of the affairs of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and given command of the military forces of the three prefectures of Qi, Huang, and Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wang Lixin was promoted to Direct Attendant of the Sublime Literary Hall, appointed prefect of Jiangzhou, put in charge of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and given command of troops in Qi, Huang, and Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，呂文福依舊職差知濠州兼淮西招撫使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Lü Wenfu was reassigned at his former rank as prefect of Hao Prefecture and concurrently Huai West Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lü Wenfu was reassigned at his former rank as prefect of Haozhou and concurrently Huai West Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，熒惑與歲星合在危。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Mars and Jupiter conjoined in the Danger.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Mars and Jupiter conjoined in the constellation Danger.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有流星大如杯。

translations.literal: On jiachen, a meteor as large as a cup appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, a meteor the size of a cup appeared.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，熒惑犯壁壘陣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renxu, Mars transgressed the Ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, Mars transgressed the Ramparts formation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: On bingyin, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「廣西靜江屯田，小試有效，其邕、欽、宜、融、柳、象、潯諸州守臣任責措置，經略安撫以課殿最，仍條具來上。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict stated: "The garrison farming at Jingjiang in Guangxi has shown modest success in trial; the prefectural officials of Yong, Qin, Yi, Rong, Liu, Xiang, and Xun are charged with responsibility for arrangements; the pacification commissioner is to assess their performance for ranking, and detailed reports are still to be submitted."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, an edict stated: "Garrison farming at Jingjiang in Guangxi has shown modest success in trial; prefectural officials in Yong, Qin, Yi, Rong, Liu, Xiang, and Xun are responsible for carrying it out; the pacification commissioner is to rank their performance, and detailed reports are to be submitted."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，馬光祖以病請祠，詔知福州兼福建安撫使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Ma Guangzu, pleading illness, requested a temple post; an edict appointed him prefect of Fuzhou and concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Ma Guangzu, citing illness, requested a temple post; an edict appointed him prefect of Fuzhou and concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賜禮部進士方山京以下六百三十七人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On dingchou, six hundred thirty-seven metropolitan graduates from Fang Shanjing downward were granted jinshi degrees and initial office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, six hundred thirty-seven metropolitan graduates from Fang Shanjing downward received jinshi degrees and initial appointments.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，夏貴上蘄縣戰功。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Xia Gui submitted a report on the battle achievements at Qi County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Xia Gui submitted a report on battle achievements at Qi County.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，詔李璮受圍，給銀五萬兩，下益都府犒師，遣青陽夢炎率師援之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi, an edict noted that Li Tan was besieged; fifty thousand taels of silver were granted and sent down to Yidu Prefecture to reward the army, and Qingyang Mengyan was dispatched to lead troops to relieve him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, an edict noted that Li Tan was under siege; fifty thousand taels of silver were sent to Yidu Prefecture to reward the troops, and Qingyang Mengyan was dispatched to lead an army to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以孫附鳳兼權參知政事，楊棟端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Sun Fufeng was made acting Vice Grand Councillor; Yang Dong, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance and Associate Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Sun Fufeng was made acting Vice Grand Councillor; Yang Dong was appointed Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, Associate Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，吳潛沒於循州，詔許歸葬。

translations.literal: On renchen, Wu Qian died at Xun Prefecture; an edict permitted his body to be returned for burial.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wu Qian died in exile at Xunzhou; an edict permitted his body to be returned home for burial.

sentences.zh: 己亥，董槐乞致仕，詔授特進。

translations.literal: On jihai, Dong Huai requested retirement; an edict granted him Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Dong Huai requested retirement; an edict granted him Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔青陽夢炎援李璮，不俟解圍，輒提援兵南歸，諭制置司劾之。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict noted that Qingyang Mengyan, sent to relieve Li Tan, had withdrawn his relief army south without waiting for the siege to be lifted; the strategic commissioner was instructed to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict noted that Qingyang Mengyan, sent to relieve Li Tan, had withdrawn his relief army south without waiting for the siege to be lifted, and instructed the strategic commissioner to impeach him.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有流星大如熒惑。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a meteor as large as Mars appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a meteor the size of Mars appeared.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，安南國王日煚上表乞世襲，詔授檢校太師、安南國王，加食邑，男威晃授靜海軍節度觀察處置使、檢校太尉兼御史大夫、上柱國、安南國王、效忠順化功臣，仍賜金帶、器幣、鞍馬。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the king of Annam, Ri Can, submitted a memorial requesting hereditary succession; an edict appointed him acting Grand Preceptor and King of Annam and increased his fief income; his son Wei Huang was appointed Military-Governor of the Tranquil Seas Army, Commissioner of Observation and Disposition, acting Grand Marshal concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Supreme Pillar of State, King of Annam, and Worthy of Merit in Loyal Submission and Transformational Rule; a gold belt, ceremonial vessels and silks, and a saddle horse were also granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Ri Can, king of Annam, submitted a memorial requesting hereditary succession; an edict appointed him acting Grand Preceptor and King of Annam and increased his fief income; his son Wei Huang was made Military-Governor of the Tranquil Seas Army, Commissioner of Observation and Disposition, acting Grand Marshal concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Supreme Pillar of State, King of Annam, and Worthy of Merit in Loyal Submission and Transformational Rule, and was also granted a gold belt, ceremonial vessels and silks, and a saddle horse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔應謫臣僚終於貶所者，許令歸葬。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict stated that exiled officials who died at their place of banishment were permitted to be returned for burial.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict permitted exiled officials who died in banishment to be returned home for burial.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔州縣官廩祿不時給者，御史台覺察，或以他物折支，計贓論罪。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, an edict stated that where prefectural and county officials' grain salaries were not paid on time, the Censorate was to investigate; where other goods were substituted in payment, the offense was to be prosecuted as embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, an edict ordered the Censorate to investigate when prefectural and county officials' grain salaries were not paid on time, and to prosecute as embezzlement cases where other goods were substituted in payment.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，董槐薨，贈少師，諡文清。

translations.literal: On renxu, Dong Huai died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Literary and Pure.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Dong Huai died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Literary and Pure.

sentences.zh: 庚午，周、漢國公主薨，賜諡端孝。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Princess of Zhou and Han died; she was granted the posthumous title Upright Filial.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Princess of Zhou and Han died; she was granted the posthumous title Upright Filial.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江州都統聶世興調遣入蜀，托疾憚行，詔奪二秩，押往京湖制司自效。

translations.literal: On renshen, Nie Shixing, commander-in-chief of Jiang Prefecture, had been ordered dispatched into Shu but feigned illness and feared to go; an edict stripped him of two ranks and sent him under escort to the Capital-Hu strategic commission to redeem himself through service.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Nie Shixing, commander-in-chief of Jiangzhou, had been ordered into Shu but feigned illness and refused to go; an edict stripped him of two ranks and sent him under escort to the Capital-Hu strategic commission to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，侍御史范純父言：「前四川制置使俞興，妒功啟戎，罷任鐫秩，罰輕，乞更褫奪，以紓衆怒。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Supervising Censor Fan Chunfu stated: "The former Sichuan strategic commissioner Yu Xing, jealous of others' achievements and provoking warfare, was dismissed and had ranks cut—a penalty too light; I request further stripping of rank to relieve public anger."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Supervising Censor Fan Chunfu stated: "The former Sichuan strategic commissioner Yu Xing, jealous of others' achievements and provoking warfare, was dismissed and had ranks cut—a penalty too light; I ask that he be further stripped of rank to relieve public anger."

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔重修《吏部七司條法》。

translations.literal: On xinsi, an edict ordered the revision of the Seven Bureaus Regulations of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, an edict ordered the revision of the Seven Bureaus Regulations of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔申嚴諸路郡縣苛取苗米之禁。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict again strictly forbade prefectures and circuits from harshly extracting seed rice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict again strictly forbade circuits and prefectures from harshly extracting seed rice.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夜有白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On jiashen, at night a white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, a white vapor stretched across the sky at night.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，海州石湫堰成，詔知州張漢英帶行遙郡刺史、馬步軍副總管，帶行環衛官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiawu, the Shitang Dam at Haizhou was completed; an edict granted Prefect Zhang Hanying acting Remote-Prefecture Censor and deputy commander of cavalry and infantry, with an acting guard-office appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, the Shitang Dam at Haizhou was completed; an edict granted Prefect Zhang Hanying acting Remote-Prefecture Censor, deputy commander of cavalry and infantry, and an acting guard-office appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，築蘄州城。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the walls of Qi Prefecture were built.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the walls of Qizhou were built.

sentences.zh: 知州王益落階官，正任高州刺史；

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Yi was reduced in honorary rank; his regular appointment was made Prefect of Gao Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Yi was reduced in honorary rank, with his regular appointment as prefect of Gaozhou;

sentences.zh: 制置使汪立信上《新城圖》，詔獎諭。

translations.literal: Strategic Commissioner Wang Lixin submitted a New City Diagram; an edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: Strategic Commissioner Wang Lixin submitted a diagram of the new city; an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，李璮兵敗，爲大元所誅，事聞，詔沿邊諸郡嚴邊防。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Li Tan's army was defeated and he was executed by the Great Yuan; when the report arrived, an edict ordered all frontier prefectures strictly to secure the borders.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Li Tan's army was defeated and he was executed by the Great Yuan; when word arrived, an edict ordered all frontier prefectures strictly to secure the borders.

sentences.zh: 汪立信升直敷文閣、主管沿江制置司公事、知江州、主管江西安撫司公事。

translations.literal: Wang Lixin was promoted to Direct Attendant of the Propagation of Culture Hall, put in charge of the affairs of the Riverine Strategic Commission, made prefect of Jiang Prefecture, and put in charge of the affairs of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lixin was promoted to Direct Attendant of the Propagation of Culture Hall, put in charge of the Riverine Strategic Commission, appointed prefect of Jiangzhou, and put in charge of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On guimao, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，沿江制置使姚希得進寶章閣學士，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On yisi, Riverine Strategic Commissioner Yao Xide was advanced to Academician of the Hall of Precious Insignia; his duties remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Riverine Strategic Commissioner Yao Xide was promoted to Academician of the Hall of Precious Insignia while retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，召陳奕赴樞密院稟議。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen, Chen Yi was summoned to the Bureau of Military Affairs for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen, Chen Yi was summoned to the Bureau of Military Affairs for consultation.

sentences.zh: 丙子，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On bingzi, a meteor as large as Venus appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, a meteor the size of Venus appeared.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，溫州布衣李元老，讀書安貧，不事科舉，今已百四歲，詔補迪功郎致仕，本郡給奉。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Li Yuanlao, a commoner of Wenzhou, read books and lived in poverty without pursuing the examinations; he was now one hundred four years old; an edict appointed him Retired Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and ordered his native prefecture to supply a stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Yuanlao, a commoner of Wenzhou who read books, lived in poverty, and never pursued the examinations, was now one hundred four years old; an edict appointed him Retired Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and ordered his native prefecture to supply a stipend.

sentences.zh: 閏九月甲申朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the new moon, jiashen, in the intercalary ninth month, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on the new moon, jiashen, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，流星透霞，大如太白。

translations.literal: On bingxu, a meteor pierced the clouds, as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, a meteor pierced the clouds, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔刑部長貳、大理卿、少卿，歲終無評事可舉，即舉在京三獄官。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict stated that if, at year's end, the senior and associate ministers of Punishments and the chief and associate judges of the Court of Judicial Review had no reviewing officials to recommend, they should recommend officials of the three capital prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, an edict stated that if, at year's end, the senior and associate ministers of Punishments and the chief and associate judges of the Court of Judicial Review had no reviewing officials to recommend, they should recommend officials of the three capital prisons instead.

sentences.zh: 庚子，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On gengzi, a meteor as large as Venus appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, a meteor the size of Venus appeared.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔應知縣罪罷，雖經赦，毋注緊、望闕，著爲令。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict stated that former prefects dismissed for crime, even if pardoned, were not to be assigned to key or prestigious vacancies; this was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict stated that former prefects dismissed for crime, even if pardoned, were not to be assigned to key or prestigious vacancies, and this was established as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔：「紹興府火，給貸居民錢，今及二載，民貧可憫，悉除勿征。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict stated: "After the fire in Shaoxing Prefecture, loans were granted to residents; two years have now passed and the people remain poor and pitiable; all debts are remitted and none are to be collected."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict stated: "After the fire in Shaoxing Prefecture, loans were granted to residents; two years have now passed and the people remain poor and pitiable; all debts are remitted and none are to be collected."

sentences.zh: 」冬十月乙卯，詔蠲四川制總、州縣鹽酒榷額。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yimao, an edict remitted the salt and wine monopoly quotas of the Sichuan overall commission and of prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yimao, an edict remitted the salt and wine monopoly quotas of the Sichuan overall commission and of prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the moon transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the moon transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以楊棟簽書樞密院事、兼權參知政事兼太子賓客，葉夢鼎端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Yang Dong was made Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, acting Vice Grand Councillor, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent; Ye Mengding, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, Associate Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Yang Dong was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, acting Vice Grand Councillor, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent; Ye Mengding was appointed Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance, Associate Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and concurrent Guest of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，呂文德言遣將校禦敵，多逗遛不進，且奏功失實，具姓名上聞。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Lü Wende reported that generals and officers sent to resist the enemy often lingered without advancing and submitted inflated battle reports, listing names and forwarding them to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Lü Wende reported that generals and officers sent to resist the enemy often lingered without advancing and submitted inflated battle reports, listing names and forwarding them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔呂文煥、王達、趙真削兩秩，馬堃、王甫削一秩，餘貶降有差。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Lü Wenhuan, Wang Da, and Zhao Zhen of two ranks each; Ma Kun and Wang Fu of one rank each; the rest received differing demotions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Lü Wenhuan, Wang Da, and Zhao Zhen of two ranks each; Ma Kun and Wang Fu of one rank each; the rest received differing demotions.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯五車星。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Five Chariots constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白入氐。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Venus entered the House.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Venus entered the House constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，歸化州岑從毅納土輸賦，獻丁壯爲王臣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Cen Congyi of Guihua Prefecture submitted his territory and paid taxes, presenting able-bodied men to serve as royal subjects.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Cen Congyi of Guihua Prefecture submitted his territory and paid taxes, presenting able-bodied men to serve as subjects of the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔改歸化爲來安州，從毅進秩修武郎、知州事，令世襲。

translations.literal: An edict redesignated Guihua as Lai'an Prefecture; Congyi was advanced to Gentleman for Martial Achievement, made prefect, and granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: An edict redesignated Guihua as Lai'an Prefecture; Congyi was promoted to Gentleman for Martial Achievement, made prefect, and granted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔安豐六安縣升軍使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict promoted Lu'an County of Anfeng to Lu'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, an edict promoted Lu'an County in Anfeng to Lu'an Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，丁大全竄貴州，招遊手，立將校，置弓矢舟楫，縱僕隸淫虐軍民，詔奪大全貴州團練使，移置新州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Ding Daquan, banished to Guizhou, recruited idle men, established commanders, set up bows, arrows, boats, and oars, and allowed his servants to commit outrages against soldiers and civilians; an edict stripped Daquan of his Guizhou regiment commander title and moved him to Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Ding Daquan, banished to Guizhou, recruited idle men, established commanders, set up bows, arrows, boats, and oars, and allowed his servants to abuse soldiers and civilians; an edict stripped Daquan of his Guizhou regiment commander title and moved him to Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，馬光祖乞祠祿，詔提舉臨安府洞霄宮、任便居住。

translations.literal: On guisi, Ma Guangzu requested a temple stipend; an edict charged him with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Ma Guangzu requested a temple stipend; an edict charged him with superintending the Dongxiao Palace of Lin'an Prefecture, with permission to live where he chose.

sentences.zh: 丙申，徐清叟薨，贈少師，諡忠簡。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Xu Qingsou died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Loyal and Simple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xu Qingsou died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Loyal and Simple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，資陽砦主萬戶小哥及其子衆家奴叛來降，詔小哥賜姓王，名永堅，補武翼大夫、夔路副總管，重慶府駐紮。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Xiao Ge, commander of the ten-thousand-household garrison at Ziyang Stockade, and his son, together with many household slaves, rebelled and came over in surrender; an edict granted Xiao Ge the surname Wang and the name Yongjian, appointed him Military-Winged Grandee and deputy overall commander of the Kuizhou route, stationed at Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Xiao Ge, commander of the ten-thousand-household garrison at Ziyang Stockade, and his son, together with many household slaves, rebelled and came over in surrender; an edict granted Xiao Ge the surname Wang and the name Yongjian, appointed him Military-Winged Grandee and deputy overall commander of the Kuizhou route, with his base at Chongqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以夏貴知廬州、淮西安撫副使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Xia Gui was made prefect of Lu Prefecture and Deputy Huai'an Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Xia Gui was appointed prefect of Luzhou and Deputy Huai'an Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，皇孫容州觀察使封資國公焯薨，贈保靜軍節度使、廣國公。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the imperial grandson Zhuo, Observation Commissioner of Rong Prefecture and Duke of Ziguo, died; he was posthumously granted Military Commissioner of the Baojing Army and Duke of Guangguo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the imperial grandson Zhuo, Observation Commissioner of Rongzhou and Duke of Ziguo, died; he was posthumously made Military Commissioner of the Baojing Army and Duke of Guangguo.

sentences.zh: 熒惑、填星合在婁。

translations.literal: Mars and Saturn conjoined in the Bond.
translations.idiomatic: Mars and Saturn conjoined in the Bond constellation.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，呂文德累疏辭兼四川宣撫，詔仍兼四川策應使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, Lü Wende repeatedly memorialized to resign his concurrent Sichuan pacification post; an edict ordered him still to serve concurrently as Sichuan Response Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, Lü Wende repeatedly memorialized to resign his concurrent Sichuan pacification post; an edict ordered him to retain the concurrent post of Sichuan Response Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬午朔，詔侍從、台諫、給舍、卿監、郎官以上及制總、監司各舉所知，不拘員限，不如所舉，行連坐法。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the new moon, renwu, an edict ordered attendant officials, censorial and remonstrance officials, drafters, supervisory officials, directorate and bureau officials and above, and overall and circuit commissioners each to recommend persons they knew, without limit on numbers; if the recommendation proved unworthy, collective punishment would apply.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the new moon, renwu, an edict ordered attendant officials, censorial and remonstrance officials, drafters, supervisory officials, directorate and bureau officials and above, and overall and circuit commissioners each to recommend persons they knew without limit on numbers; if a recommendation proved unworthy, collective punishment would apply.

sentences.zh: 戊子，林希逸言蒲陽布衣林亦之、陳藻有道之士，林公遇幼承父澤，奉親不仕，詔林亦之、陳藻贈迪功郎，林公遇元官上進贈一官。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Lin Xiyi stated that the commoners of Puyang, Lin Yizhi and Chen Zao, were men of the Way; Lin Gongyu in youth inherited his father's bounty and served his parents without taking office; an edict posthumously granted Lin Yizhi and Chen Zao the rank Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement, and granted Lin Gongyu one further rank above his original office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Lin Xiyi stated that the Puyang commoners Lin Yizhi and Chen Zao were men of the Way; Lin Gongyu in youth had inherited his father's bounty and served his parents without taking office; an edict posthumously granted Lin Yizhi and Chen Zao the rank Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and granted Lin Gongyu one rank above his original office.

sentences.zh: 詔董宋臣同提舉奉安符寶所，仍奉祠祿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Dong Songchen concurrently to superintend the Hall for the Preservation of the Imperial Talismans and Seals, while still granting a temple stipend.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dong Songchen concurrently to superintend the Hall for the Preservation of the Imperial Talismans and Seals, while still granting him a temple stipend.

sentences.zh: 己亥，嚴州火。

translations.literal: On jihai, Yan Prefecture suffered a fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yanzhou suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔革詞訴改送之弊。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict reformed the abuse of redirecting legal petitions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict reformed the abuse of redirecting legal petitions.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，詔吳潛、丁大全黨人遷謫已久，遠者量移，近者還本貫，並不復用。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guichou, an edict stated that partisans of Wu Qian and Ding Daquan, long banished or exiled, were to be transferred closer if far away or returned to their native districts if near, but were not to be employed again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, an edict stated that associates of Wu Qian and Ding Daquan, long banished or exiled, were to be transferred closer if far away or returned to their native districts if near, but were not to be employed again.

sentences.zh: 丁大全溺死藤州，詔許歸葬。

translations.literal: Ding Daquan drowned at Teng Prefecture; an edict permitted his body to be returned for burial.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Daquan drowned at Tengzhou; an edict permitted his body to be returned home for burial.

sentences.zh: 詔俞興往歲失陷瀘城，更削一秩。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Yu Xing, for losing Luzhou city the previous year, was further stripped of one rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict further stripped Yu Xing of one rank for having lost Luzhou the previous year.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，置官田所，以劉良貴爲提領，陳訔爲檢閱。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an Official Fields Office was established; Liu Lianggui was made superintendent and Chen Yin inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court established an Official Fields Office, appointing Liu Lianggui superintendent and Chen Yin inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊午，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a complete solar halo appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a complete solar halo encircled the sun.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，呂文德浚築鄂州、常、澧城池訖事，詔獎之，守臣韓宣轉遙郡承宣使，蘇劉義吉州刺史。

translations.literal: On yihai, Lü Wende completed dredging and fortifying the walls of E Prefecture, Chang, and Li; an edict commended him; the defending official Han Xuan was transferred to remote-prefecture honorary commissioner; Su Liuyi was made prefect of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Lü Wende completed dredging and fortifying the walls of Ezhou, Chang, and Li; an edict commended him; the defending official Han Xuan was transferred to remote-prefecture honorary commissioner, and Su Liuyi was made prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，以呂文德爲寧武、保康軍節度使，職任依舊；

translations.literal: In the third month, on dinghai, Lü Wende was made Military Commissioner of the Ningwu and Baokang Armies, his duties remaining as before;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, Lü Wende was appointed Military Commissioner of the Ningwu and Baokang Armies, with his duties unchanged;

sentences.zh: 劉雄飛樞密都承旨、四川安撫制置使兼知重慶府、四川總領財賦、夔路轉運使。

translations.literal: Liu Xiongfei was made Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Chongqing, Sichuan Chief Fiscal Officer, and Kuizhou Circuit transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiongfei was appointed Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Chongqing, Sichuan Chief Fiscal Officer, and Kuizhou Circuit transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 加授姚希得刑部尚書，李庭芝兵部侍郎，朱禩孫太府卿，汪立信太府少卿，並依舊任。

translations.literal: Yao Xide was additionally appointed Minister of Punishments; Li Tingzhi Vice Minister of War; Zhu Suisun Minister of the Palace Storehouse; Wang Lixin Vice Minister of the Palace Storehouse; all retaining their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xide was additionally appointed Minister of Punishments; Li Tingzhi Vice Minister of War; Zhu Suisun Minister of the Palace Storehouse; Wang Lixin Vice Minister of the Palace Storehouse; all while retaining their former posts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陽赤黃暈。

translations.literal: On renchen, the sun produced a red-yellow halo.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the sun displayed a red-yellow halo.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以王堅知和州兼管內安撫使，呂思望知濠州兼淮西招撫使。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Wang Jian was made prefect of He Prefecture and concurrently commissioner for pacification within the circuit; Lü Siwang was made prefect of Hao Prefecture and concurrently Huai-West Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Jian was appointed prefect of Hezhou and concurrent commissioner for circuit pacification; Lü Siwang was appointed prefect of Haozhou and concurrent Huai-West Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以何夢然兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, He Mengran was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi He Mengran was appointed Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔知寧國府趙汝禖推行經界，不擾而辦，職事修舉，升直華文閣，依舊任。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict noted that Zhao Ruchen, prefect of Ningguo Prefecture, had implemented field boundaries without disturbance and had accomplished his duties; he was promoted to Direct Academician of the Hall of Flowering Culture, while remaining in his post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict noted that Zhao Ruchen, prefect of Ningguo, had implemented the land-survey boundaries without disturbing the populace and had conducted his duties well; he was promoted to Direct Academician of the Hall of Flowering Culture while remaining in office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，忠州防禦使貴傑授福州觀察使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Gui Jie, commissioner of defense of Zhong Prefecture, was appointed observation commissioner of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Gui Jie, commissioner of defense of Zhongzhou, was appointed observation commissioner of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，太陰犯權星。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the moon transgressed the Weight Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the moon transgressed the Weight Star.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，官田所言，知嘉興縣段浚、知宜興縣葉哲佐買公田不遵元制，詔罷之。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Official Fields Office reported that Duan Jun, magistrate of Jiaxing County, and Ye Zhezuo, magistrate of Yixing County, had purchased public fields without following the original regulations; an edict dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Official Fields Office reported that Duan Jun, magistrate of Jiaxing County, and Ye Zhezuo, magistrate of Yixing County, had purchased public fields without following the original regulations; an edict dismissed them from office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太陽赤黃暈，不匝。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the sun produced a red-yellow halo that did not encircle it completely.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the sun displayed an incomplete red-yellow halo.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin, the moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, the moon entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，婺州布衣何基，建寧府布衣徐幾，皆得理學之傳。

translations.literal: On dingyou, He Ji, a commoner of Wuzhou, and Xu Ji, a commoner of Jianning Prefecture, had both received the transmission of Neo-Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou He Ji, a commoner of Wuzhou, and Xu Ji, a commoner of Jianning, had both received the transmission of Neo-Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 詔各補迪功郎，何基婺州教授兼麗澤書院山長，徐幾建寧府教授兼建安書院山長。

translations.literal: An edict appointed each Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement; He Ji became professor of Wuzhou and concurrently head of the Lize Academy; Xu Ji became professor of Jianning Prefecture and concurrently head of the Jian'an Academy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed each to the rank of Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement; He Ji was made professor of Wuzhou and concurrently head of the Lize Academy, and Xu Ji was made professor of Jianning and concurrently head of the Jian'an Academy.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，四川制司言：二月甲寅，大元兵攻嘉定城，馬堃出戰禦之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Sichuan Commission reported: "In the second month, on jiayin, Great Yuan troops attacked Jiading city; Ma Kun went out to fight and repelled them."
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Sichuan Commission reported that in the second month, on jiayin, Great Yuan forces had attacked Jiading and Ma Kun had gone out to battle and repelled them.

sentences.zh: 詔馬堃援夔遷延，削一秩，令以所轉四官理作敘復。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Ma Kun had delayed in sending relief to Kuizhou and stripped him of one rank, ordering that the four ranks he had gained be reckoned toward restoration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Ma Kun of one rank for delaying relief to Kuizhou and ordered that the four ranks he had gained be reckoned toward his restoration.

sentences.zh: 流星出自角宿距星。

translations.literal: A meteor issued from the distance star of the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor appeared from the Horn constellation's distance star.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renzi, prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，京城火。

translations.literal: On yimao, a fire broke out in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a fire broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔饒虎臣敘復元官，依舊提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict restored Rao Huchen to his original rank and ordered him to continue superintending the Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict restored Rao Huchen to his original rank and reappointed him to superintend the Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔：平江、江陰、安吉、嘉興、常州、鎮江六郡已買公田三百五十餘萬畝，今秋成在邇，其荊湖、江西諸道，仍舊和糴。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict stated: "The six prefectures of Pingjiang, Jiangyin, Anji, Jiaxing, Chang, and Zhenjiang have already purchased more than 3.5 million mu of public fields; the autumn harvest is near; the circuits of Jinghu and Jiangxi are to continue the old policy of negotiated purchase of grain."
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict declared that the six prefectures of Pingjiang, Jiangyin, Anji, Jiaxing, Chang, and Zhenjiang had already purchased more than 3.5 million mu of public fields and that the autumn harvest was near, while the Jinghu and Jiangxi circuits were to continue the old policy of negotiated grain purchase.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔公田竣事，劉良貴官兩轉，陳訔、廖邦傑洎六郡官進秩有差。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict stated that with the public-field project completed, Liu Lianggui advanced two ranks; Chen Yin, Liao Bangjie, and the officials of the six prefectures received differing promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict noted that with the public-field project completed, Liu Lianggui advanced two ranks in office; Chen Yin, Liao Bangjie, and the officials of the six prefectures received differing promotions.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，流星出自河鼓。

translations.literal: On dingmao, a meteor issued from the Drum at the River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a meteor appeared from the Drum at the River.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宰執進《玉牒》、《日曆》、《會要》、《經武要略》及《徽宗長編》、《寧宗實錄》，詔賈似道以下官兩轉。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the chief ministers presented the Jade Genealogy, Calendar, Compendium of Institutions, Essentials of Military Governance, Extended Records of Huizong, and Veritable Records of Ningzong; an edict granted Jia Sidao and those below him two ranks each.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the chief ministers presented the Jade Genealogy, Calendar, Compendium of Institutions, Essentials of Military Governance, Extended Records of Huizong, and Veritable Records of Ningzong; an edict granted Jia Sidao and his subordinates two ranks each.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，敕令所進《寧宗以來寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, the Edict Office presented the Broadly Compassionate Edicts since Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, the Edict Office presented the Broadly Compassionate Edicts since Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以董宋臣爲入內內侍省押班。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Dong Songchen was made head clerk of the Inner Palace Service of the Inner Attendant Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Dong Songchen was appointed head clerk of the Inner Palace Service of the Inner Attendant Bureau.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，董宋臣以病乞收回恩命，請祠，詔賜告五月。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Dong Songchen, citing illness, requested withdrawal of his favor and asked for a temple appointment; an edict granted him five months' leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Dong Songchen, citing illness, requested withdrawal of his recent favor and asked for a temple appointment; an edict granted him five months' leave.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，流星出自天倉星。

translations.literal: On yimao, a meteor issued from the Heavenly Granary Star.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a meteor appeared from the Heavenly Granary Star.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，詔趙汝禖爲太府少卿、淮東總領財賦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiashen, an edict made Zhao Ruchen Vice Minister of the Palace Storehouse and Chief Fiscal Officer of Huai East.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, an edict appointed Zhao Ruchen Vice Minister of the Palace Storehouse and Chief Fiscal Officer of Huai East.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以何夢然知樞密院事兼參知政事，楊棟同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，葉夢鼎簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiawu, He Mengran was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Vice Grand Councilor; Yang Dong was made Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Acting Vice Grand Councilor; Ye Mengding was made Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu He Mengran was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Vice Grand Councilor; Yang Dong was appointed Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Acting Vice Grand Councilor; Ye Mengding was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，詔發緡錢百四十萬，命浙西六郡置公田莊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, an edict disbursed 1.4 million strings of cash and ordered the six prefectures of western Zhe to establish public-field estates.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, an edict disbursed 1.4 million strings of cash and ordered the six prefectures of western Zhe to establish public-field estates.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命張玨興元府駐紮、御前諸軍都統制兼知合州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Zhang Jue was ordered stationed at Xingyuan Prefecture as Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Armies and concurrently prefect of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Jue was ordered stationed at Xingyuan as Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Armies and concurrently prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，福州火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jihai, Fuzhou suffered a fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai, Fuzhou suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未朔，詔皇太子宮講官詹事以下，日輪一員，辰入酉出，專講讀，備咨問，以稱輔導之實。

translations.literal: On the first day dingwei of the twelfth month, an edict ordered that among the lecturers of the Heir Apparent's Palace, from the steward downward one official each day should rotate in from the chen hour and leave at the you hour, devoted solely to lecturing, ready for consultation, to fulfill the substance of tutelage.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day dingwei of the twelfth month, an edict ordered that among the lecturers of the Heir Apparent's Palace, from the steward downward officials should rotate daily, entering at the chen hour and leaving at the you hour, devoted solely to lecturing and ready for consultation, to fulfill the substance of tutelage.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔在京置窠柵、私系囚並非法獄具，台憲其嚴禁戢，違者有刑。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict stated that irregular detention facilities, private imprisonment of prisoners, and unlawful instruments of torture in the capital were strictly forbidden by the Censorate; violators would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict strictly forbade irregular detention facilities, private imprisonment, and unlawful torture instruments in the capital; violators would be punished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太白、歲星順行。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Venus and Jupiter proceeded direct.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Venus and Jupiter proceeded in direct motion.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁丑朔，詔崇經術，考德行。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month of spring, on the first day dingchou, an edict honored the classics and examined moral conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the first day dingchou of the first month of spring, an edict honored the classics and examined moral conduct.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，出奉宸庫珠，香、象、犀等貨下務場貨易，助收幣楮。

translations.literal: On guisi, pearls, incense, ivory, rhinoceros horn, and other goods from the Imperial Treasury were released to trade offices to aid in recovering paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi pearls, incense, ivory, rhinoceros horn, and other goods from the Imperial Treasury were released to trade offices to aid in recovering paper currency.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太子右諭德湯漢三乞休致，授秘閣修撰、知福州、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Tang Han, Right Tutor of the Heir Apparent, thrice requested retirement; he was appointed Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Tang Han, Right Tutor of the Heir Apparent, thrice requested retirement and was appointed Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，流星出自畢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renxu, a meteor issued from the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, a meteor appeared from the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the moon transgressed the Chamber mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the moon transgressed the Chamber constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the moon transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the moon transgressed the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雨土。

translations.literal: On xinwei, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，王堅卒，賜諡忠壯。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi, Wang Jian died; he was granted the posthumous title Loyal and Stalwart.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi, Wang Jian died and was granted the posthumous title Loyal and Stalwart.

sentences.zh: 馬光祖依舊觀文殿學士、沿江制置使、知建康府、江東安撫使、行宮留守。

translations.literal: Ma Guangzu retained his posts as Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Yangzi-River Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Jiankang Prefecture, Jiang-East Pacification Commissioner, and Palatial Guard Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Guangzu retained his posts as Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Yangzi-River Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Jiankang, Jiang-East Pacification Commissioner, and Palatial Guard Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己丑，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On jichou, a complete solar halo appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou a complete solar halo encircled the sun.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，詔：管景模妻孥陷沒，效忠愈堅，平時所得奉入，率以撫恤將士，遂至空乏，特賜緡錢三十萬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu, an edict stated: "Guan Jingmo's wife and children were captured, yet he grew firmer in loyalty; his ordinary salary he generally used to comfort the troops, until he was utterly destitute; he was specially granted three hundred thousand strings of cash."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu, an edict noted that though Guan Jingmo's wife and children had been captured, he had grown firmer in loyalty, that he had generally spent his salary comforting his troops until he was utterly destitute, and that he was specially granted three hundred thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 尋賜金帶。

translations.literal: Soon afterward a gold belt was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以夏貴爲樞密都承旨、四川安撫制置使兼知重慶府、四川總領、夔路轉運使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Xia Gui was made Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Chongqing, Sichuan Chief Fiscal Officer, and Kuizhou Circuit transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xia Gui was appointed Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Chongqing, Sichuan Chief Fiscal Officer, and Kuizhou Circuit transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔郡邑行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict ordered commanderies and counties to perform the village drinking ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict ordered commanderies and counties to perform the village drinking ceremony.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰入太微垣。

translations.literal: On guichou, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，信陽軍將領余元友等提兵防護春耕有功，補轉兩官資。

translations.literal: On yimao, the generals of Xinyang Army, Yu Yuanyou and others, for leading troops to protect spring plowing with merit, were granted two ranks in office.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Xinyang Army generals Yu Yuanyou and others, for leading troops to protect spring plowing with merit, were granted two ranks in office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，何夢然、馬天驥以台臣劾罷。

translations.literal: On yichou, He Mengran and Ma Tianji were dismissed on censorial impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou He Mengran and Ma Tianji were dismissed following censorial impeachment.

sentences.zh: 己巳，江萬里以資政殿學士知建寧府，李曾伯以觀文殿學士知慶元府、沿海制置使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Jiang Wanli, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was made prefect of Jianning Prefecture; Li Zengbo, Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, was made prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Jiang Wanli, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was appointed prefect of Jianning; Li Zengbo, Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, was appointed prefect of Qingyuan and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白、歲星合于婁。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Bond mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Bond constellation.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，何夢然以資政殿大學士知建寧府。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengchen, He Mengran, Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was made prefect of Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen, He Mengran, Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was appointed prefect of Jianning.

sentences.zh: 辛卿，以楊棟參知政事，葉夢鼎同知樞密院事權參知政事，姚希得端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事，馬天驥提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Yang Dong was made Vice Grand Councilor; Ye Mengding Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Grand Councilor; Yao Xide Academician of the Hall of Bright Governance and Associate Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ma Tianji was charged with superintending the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yang Dong was appointed Vice Grand Councilor; Ye Mengding was appointed Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Grand Councilor; Yao Xide was appointed Academician of the Hall of Bright Governance and Associate Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ma Tianji was assigned to superintend the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，流星出自河鼓，大如太白。

translations.literal: On jiawu, a meteor issued from the Drum at the River, as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a meteor appeared from the Drum at the River, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 乙未，安南國奉表謝恩，進方物，詔卻之，仍賜金帛，以獎恭順。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Annam presented a memorial giving thanks, offering tribute goods; an edict declined them yet still granted gold and silk to reward respect and obedience.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Annam presented a memorial of thanks and offered tribute goods; an edict declined the goods yet still granted gold and silk to reward its respectful obedience.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白經天，晝見。

translations.literal: On jihai, Venus crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Venus crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，知衢州謝塈因寇焚掠常山縣棄城遁，詔削三秩，褫職不敘。

translations.literal: On the first day jiachen of the sixth month, Xie Ji, prefect of Qu Prefecture, because bandits burned and plundered Changshan County abandoned the city and fled; an edict stripped him of three ranks, removed his office, and barred restoration.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiachen of the sixth month, Xie Ji, prefect of Quzhou, because bandits had burned and plundered Changshan County abandoned the city and fled; an edict stripped him of three ranks, removed him from office, and barred restoration.

sentences.zh: 台臣言衢州詹沔之變，乃謝塈任都吏徐信苛取激之，塈罪重罰輕。

translations.literal: Censors stated that the disturbance at Quzhou's Zhan River was caused by Xie Ji employing the chief clerk Xu Xin, whose harsh exactions provoked it; Xie's crime was grave but his penalty light.
translations.idiomatic: Censors stated that the disturbance at Quzhou's Zhan River had been provoked by Xie Ji's chief clerk Xu Xin, whose harsh exactions had stirred unrest; Xie's crime was grave but his penalty light.

sentences.zh: 詔斬信，籍其家，塈再削兩秩勒停。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xu Xin beheaded and his household registered for confiscation; Xie Ji was again stripped of two ranks and compulsorily dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xu Xin beheaded and his household confiscated; Xie Ji was again stripped of two ranks and compulsorily dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔饒虎臣敘復資政殿學士，依前通奉大夫，差遣如故。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict restored Rao Huchen as Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, retaining his former rank of Tongfeng Grand Master, with his assignment unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict restored Rao Huchen as Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, retaining his former rank of Tongfeng Grand Master, with his assignment unchanged.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，加授李庭芝寶章閣直學士，依舊任，朱禩孫右文殿修撰、知靜江府、廣西經略使，汪立信秘閣修撰、樞密副都承旨、沿江制置副使兼知江州、江西安撫使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Tingzhi was additionally appointed Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion, retaining his former post; Zhu Suisun was made Compiler of the Youwen Hall, prefect of Jingjiang Prefecture, and Guangxi Frontier Commissioner; Wang Lixin was made Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, Vice Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Yangzi-River Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Jiang Prefecture and Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Tingzhi was additionally appointed Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion while retaining his former post; Zhu Suisun was appointed Compiler of the Youwen Hall, prefect of Jingjiang, and Guangxi Frontier Commissioner; Wang Lixin was appointed Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, Vice Chief Receptionist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Yangzi-River Pacification Commissioner, concurrently prefect of Jiangzhou and Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔呂文德職事修舉，與官一轉。

translations.literal: An edict noted that Lü Wende had accomplished his duties well and granted him one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Lü Wende had conducted his duties well and granted him one promotion in rank.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯心。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祈雨。

translations.literal: On wuwu, prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 太白犯天關星。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed the Celestial Gate Star.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Celestial Gate Star.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命董宋臣兼主管御前馬院、御前酒庫。

translations.literal: On yichou, Dong Songchen was ordered concurrently to administer the Imperial Horse Pasturage and the Imperial Wine Warehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Dong Songchen was ordered concurrently to administer the Imperial Horse Pasturage and the Imperial Wine Warehouse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，熒惑、歲星並行。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Mars and Jupiter proceeded together.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Mars and Jupiter proceeded together.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白、太陰並行入井。

translations.literal: On jisi, Venus and the moon proceeded together into the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Venus and the moon proceeded together into the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陽赤黃暈。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the sun produced a red-yellow halo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the sun displayed a red-yellow halo.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，彗星出柳。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, a comet appeared from the Willow mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, a comet appeared from the Willow constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔避殿減膳，應中外臣僚許直言朝政闕失。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict ordered withdrawal from the hall and reduced meals; officials within and without were permitted to speak frankly on failures in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict ordered withdrawal from the hall and reduced meals, permitting officials inside and outside the court to speak frankly on failures in governance.

sentences.zh: 己卯，流星出自右攝提星，彗星退於鬼。

translations.literal: On jimao, a meteor issued from the right Warden of Age Star; the comet withdrew into the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a meteor appeared from the right Warden of Age Star; the comet withdrew into the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，彗星退于井。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the comet withdrew into the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the comet withdrew into the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，京城大火。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, a great fire broke out in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu a great fire broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，謝奕昌卒，贈少保，追封臨海郡王，諡莊憲。

translations.literal: On guisi, Xie Yichang died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian and enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai, with posthumous title Solemn and Lawful.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xie Yichang died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian and enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai with the posthumous title Solemn and Lawful.

sentences.zh: 甲午，填星守畢。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Saturn garrisoned the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Saturn garrisoned the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，馬天驥以台臣劾其貪贓，奪職罷祠，其子時楙削一秩、罷新任。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Ma Tianji, on censorial impeachment for greed and corruption, was stripped of office and dismissed from his temple appointment; his son Shi Mao was stripped of one rank and removed from his new appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Ma Tianji, impeached by censors for greed and corruption, was stripped of office and dismissed from his temple appointment; his son Shi Mao was stripped of one rank and removed from his new appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，知嘉定府洪濤言：新繁縣御容殿前枯木再榮，殿有畫太祖像；

translations.literal: On bingshen, Hong Tao, prefect of Jiading Prefecture, reported: "Before the Imperial Portrait Hall at Xinfan County a withered tree blossomed again; the hall bears a painted portrait of Taizu;"
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Hong Tao, prefect of Jiading, reported that before the Imperial Portrait Hall at Xinfan County a withered tree had blossomed again and that the hall bore a painted portrait of Taizu;

sentences.zh: 又順化人楊嗣光等奉太宗、真宗、仁宗、英宗、神宗像來歸，令櫝藏府中天慶觀。

translations.literal: Further, Yang Siguang of Shunhua and others brought portraits of Taizong, Zhenzong, Renzong, Yingzong, and Shenzong to submit; they were ordered encased and stored at the Tianqing Abbey in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Further, Yang Siguang of Shunhua and others brought portraits of Taizong, Zhenzong, Renzong, Yingzong, and Shenzong to submit; an edict ordered them encased and stored at the Tianqing Abbey in the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔本府選差武臣迎奉赴行在所，嗣光補武階兩資。

translations.literal: An edict ordered this prefecture to select a military officer to escort them to the mobile court; Siguang was granted two ranks in the military hierarchy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the prefecture to select a military officer to escort the portraits to the mobile court; Siguang was granted two ranks in the military hierarchy.

sentences.zh: 祈雨。

translations.literal: Prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: The court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 台臣言太子賓客楊棟指彗爲蚩尤旗，欺天罔君，詔棟罷職予祠。

translations.literal: Censors stated that Yang Dong, Tutor to the Heir Apparent, had called the comet the Banner of Chiyou, deceiving Heaven and misleading the ruler; an edict dismissed Dong from office and granted him a temple appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Censors stated that Yang Dong, Tutor to the Heir Apparent, had called the comet the Banner of Chiyou, deceiving Heaven and misleading the ruler; an edict dismissed Dong from office and granted him a temple appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，彗星退於參。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the comet withdrew into the Three Stars mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the comet withdrew into the Three Stars constellation.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅朔，熒惑與填星合。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin of the eighth month, Mars and Saturn conjoined.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renyin of the eighth month, Mars and Saturn conjoined.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以楊棟知建寧府。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Yang Dong was made prefect of Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Yang Dong was appointed prefect of Jianning.

sentences.zh: 戊午，彗星消伏。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the comet vanished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，彗星復見於參。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the comet reappeared in the Three Stars mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the comet reappeared in the Three Stars constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛未，彗星化爲霞氣。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the comet transformed into cloud-glow vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the comet dissolved into cloud-glow vapor.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，日生格氣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jichou, the sun developed obstructive vapor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou, the sun developed obstructive vapor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，內侍李忠輔以台臣劾其貪肆欺罔，削兩秩放罷。

translations.literal: On guisi, the inner attendant Li Zhongfu, on censorial impeachment for greed, arrogance, and deception, was stripped of two ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the inner attendant Li Zhongfu, impeached by censors for greed, arrogance, and deception, was stripped of two ranks and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，建寧府教授謝枋得校文宣城及建康漕闈，發策十餘問，言權奸誤國，趙氏必亡。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Xie Fangde, professor of Jianning Prefecture, examined candidates at the transport examinations of Xuancheng and Jiankang, setting more than ten questions stating that powerful traitors had misled the state and the House of Zhao was doomed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Xie Fangde, professor of Jianning Prefecture, served as examiner at the transport examinations of Xuancheng and Jiankang, setting more than ten questions declaring that powerful traitors had misled the state and that the House of Zhao was doomed to fall.

sentences.zh: 左司諫舒有開劾其怨望騰謗，大不敬，竄興國軍。

translations.literal: Left Remonstrator Shu Youkai impeached him for resentful slander and gross disrespect, and he was exiled to Xingguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Left Remonstrator Shu Youkai impeached him for resentful slander and gross disrespect, and he was exiled to Xingguo Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu, the moon transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu, the moon transgressed the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔十七界會浸輕，並以十八界會易之，限一月止。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict stated that the Seventeenth-Realm notes had gradually depreciated and were all to be exchanged for Eighteenth-Realm notes, the exchange to cease after one month.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, an edict declared that Seventeenth-Realm paper notes had gradually lost value and were to be exchanged for Eighteenth-Realm notes, with the exchange limited to one month.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔行關子銅錢法，每百作七十七文足，以一準十八界會之三。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict ordered implementation of the Guanzi copper-cash standard, reckoning every hundred as seventy-seven full cash, with one unit equal to three of the Eighteenth-Realm notes.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict ordered implementation of the Guanzi copper-cash standard, reckoning every hundred as seventy-seven full cash, with one unit equal to three Eighteenth-Realm notes.

sentences.zh: 帝有疾，不視朝。

translations.literal: The emperor fell ill and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fell ill and ceased to hold court.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On bingyin, a general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝崩。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 遺詔皇太子禥即皇帝位。

translations.literal: His testamentary edict ordered Crown Prince Qi to ascend the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: His testamentary edict ordered Crown Prince Qi to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 咸淳元年三月甲申，葬於會稽之永穆陵。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xianchun, on jiashen, he was buried at Yongmu Mausoleum in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Xianchun, on jiashen, he was buried at Yongmu Mausoleum in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月丙戌，諡曰建道備德大功復興烈文仁武聖明安孝皇帝，廟號理宗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year, on bingxu, his posthumous title was given as Emperor Jian Dao Bei De Da Gong Fu Xing Lie Wen Ren Wu Sheng Ming An Xiao, and his temple name was Lizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year, on bingxu, he was given the posthumous title Emperor of Establishing the Way, Complete in Virtue, Great in Achievement, Restoring the Dynasty, Majestic in Culture, Benevolent in Martial Affairs, Sagely, Bright, Tranquil, and Filial, with the temple name Lizong.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：理宗享國久長，與仁宗同。

translations.literal: The encomium states: Lizong enjoyed the throne for a long time, the same as Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: Lizong enjoyed a long reign, equal to that of Renzong.

sentences.zh: 然仁宗之世，賢相相繼。

translations.literal: Yet in Renzong's age worthy chief ministers succeeded one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in Renzong's time worthy chief ministers succeeded one another.

sentences.zh: 理宗四十年之間，若李宗勉、崔與之、吳潛之賢，皆弗究於用；

translations.literal: In Lizong's forty years, worthy men such as Li Zongmian, Cui Zhizhi, and Wu Qian were none of them fully employed;
translations.idiomatic: During Lizong's forty years, worthy men such as Li Zongmian, Cui Zhizhi, and Wu Qian were never fully put to use;

sentences.zh: 而史彌遠、丁大全、賈似道竊弄威福，與相始終。

translations.literal: while Shi Miyuan, Ding Daquan, and Jia Sidao usurped authority and favor from beginning to end as chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: while Shi Miyuan, Ding Daquan, and Jia Sidao usurped power and favor, serving as chief ministers from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 治效之不及慶曆、嘉祐，宜也。

translations.literal: That his governance did not reach the level of Qingli and Jiayou is only to be expected.
translations.idiomatic: That his governance fell short of the Qingli and Jiayou eras was only to be expected.

sentences.zh: 蔡州之役，幸依大朝以定夾攻之策，及函守緒遺骨，俘宰臣天綱，歸獻廟社，亦可以刷會稽之恥，復齊襄之仇矣。

translations.literal: In the campaign at Caizhou, he was fortunate to rely on the Great Court to fix the strategy of converging attack; when the bones of Shouxu were sent in a casket and the chief minister Tiangang was captured and presented to the ancestral temple, he might also have washed away the shame of Kuaiji and avenged the wrong done to Duke Xiang of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Caizhou campaign, he was fortunate to rely on the Great Court to settle a strategy of converging attack; when Shouxu's bones were sent in a casket and the chief minister Tiangang was captured and presented at the ancestral temple, he might have washed away the shame of Kuaiji and avenged the wrong done to Duke Xiang of Qi.

sentences.zh: 顧乃貪地棄盟，入洛之師，事釁隨起，兵連禍結，境土日蹙。

translations.literal: Yet he was greedy for territory and abandoned the alliance; the army that entered Luoyang provoked incidents in its wake, war linked to disaster, and the realm daily shrank.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he grew greedy for territory and abandoned the alliance; the army sent into Luoyang provoked fresh incidents, war bred disaster upon disaster, and the realm shrank day by day.

sentences.zh: 郝經來使，似道諱言其納幣請和，蒙蔽抑塞，拘留不報，自速滅亡。

translations.literal: When Hao Jing came as envoy, Sidao concealed his offer of tribute and plea for peace, deceived and obstructed him, detained him without response, and thus hastened destruction.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao Jing came as envoy, Sidao concealed his offer of tribute and plea for peace, deceived and obstructed the court, detained him without reply, and thus hastened the dynasty's ruin.

sentences.zh: 籲，可惜哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how regrettable!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, what a pity!

sentences.zh: 由其中年嗜欲既多，怠于政事，權移奸臣，經筵性命之講，徒資虛談，固無益也。

translations.literal: From his middle years his appetites grew many, he grew slack in government, power shifted to treacherous ministers, and lectures on nature and fate at the classics mat were mere empty talk, truly of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: From his middle years his appetites multiplied, he grew slack in government, power passed to treacherous ministers, and lectures on nature and fate at the classics mat amounted to empty talk that truly did no good.

sentences.zh: 雖然，宋嘉定以來，正邪貿亂，國是靡定，自帝繼統，首黜王安石孔廟從祀，升濂、洛九儒，表章朱熹《四書》，丕變士習，視前朝奸黨之碑、偽學之禁，豈不大有徑庭也哉！

translations.literal: Nevertheless, since the Jiading era of Song, orthodox and heterodox had been confused and the national policy unsettled; from the time this emperor succeeded to the throne he first removed Wang Anshi from the Confucian temple sacrifices, elevated the nine scholars of Lian and Luo, and honored Zhu Xi's Four Books, greatly transforming scholarly custom—compared with the previous dynasty's stele of treacherous factions and ban on heterodox learning, was this not a great departure!
translations.idiomatic: Nevertheless, since the Jiading era, orthodox and heterodox learning had been confused and national policy unsettled; from the time this emperor succeeded he first removed Wang Anshi from Confucian temple sacrifices, elevated the nine scholars of Lian and Luo, and honored Zhu Xi's Four Books, greatly transforming scholarly custom—compared with the previous dynasty's stele of treacherous factions and ban on heterodox learning, was this not a world apart!

sentences.zh: 身當季運，弗獲大效，後世有以理學復古帝王之治者，考論匡直輔翼之功，實自帝始焉。

translations.literal: He himself stood in a declining age and did not achieve great effect, yet if later ages should restore the governance of ancient emperors through Neo-Confucian learning, those who examine the merit of upright assistance will find that it truly began with this emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He himself stood in a declining age and achieved little in his lifetime, yet if later ages should restore the governance of ancient emperors through Neo-Confucian learning, those who weigh the merit of upright assistance will find that it truly began with this emperor.

sentences.zh: 廟號曰「理」，其殆庶乎！

translations.literal: His temple name is Li, and it is perhaps not far from the mark!
translations.idiomatic: His temple name is Li, and it is perhaps not far from the mark!
